missions.title: Build a three-clue escape room
missions.description: Hide a small treat, chain three clues to it, and watch your partner try to puzzle their way to the prize.
missions.supplies: Paper, a pen and a small treat or trinket
steps: Hide a small treat somewhere in one room.
Write the clue that leads to the treat first, hide it, then write a clue that leads to that hiding spot.
Do it once more so you have three clues, and hand your partner the first one.
Swap roles and let them build a trail for you.
missions.finish: You've both found each other's treat.
missions.apart: Hide the clues in your own room and give a live video tour; your partner solves each one and directs you where to look next.

missions.title: Plan a three-stop walk
missions.description: Pick a view, a mystery and a good sit-down spot within walking distance, then link them into one small adventure.
steps: Each pick one stop: somewhere with a view, and somewhere one of you has never been.
Choose a third stop together where you can sit for a while.
Walk the route and spend at least five minutes at each stop.
Give your route a grand name on the way home.
missions.finish: You've visited all three stops and named the route.
missions.apart: Each walk your own three stops and send a photo from every stop as you reach it.

missions.title: Four-ingredient pantry challenge
missions.description: Raid the cupboards for exactly four ingredients and turn them into something you'd proudly serve on a fancy plate.
steps: Each secretly pick four ingredients you already have (salt, pepper and oil are free).
Swap your four with your partner's.
Make one small dish from the four you were given and plate it like a fancy restaurant would.
Give each dish a ridiculous menu name, then taste both.
missions.finish: Both dishes have been named, tasted and judged.
missions.apart: Each pick four ingredients from your own kitchen, read them out on a video call, cook at the same time and present your plates to the camera.

missions.title: Swap scavenger hunt lists
missions.description: Send each other five oddly specific things to find at home, then show off your finds on a video call.
missions.supplies: Your phone and whatever's at home
steps: Write five prompts for your partner, like "something older than you" or "the softest thing you own".
Swap lists and set a ten-minute timer.
Hunt through your own place for a match to every prompt.
Get on a video call and present each find with the story behind it.
missions.finish: Every item on both lists has been found and shown off.
missions.apart: Made for distance: swap lists by text and do the reveal on a call or as a photo thread.

missions.title: Shoot a five-clip movie
missions.description: Five clips, three seconds each: a hero, a problem, a twist, a rescue and a big finish. A mug can be the hero.
steps: Pick a hero from whatever's nearby: a mug, a houseplant, a sock.
Film five three-second clips in order: hero, problem, twist, rescue, ending.
Play it back while one of you narrates like a movie trailer.
missions.finish: Your fifteen-second epic has had its premiere.
missions.apart: Each film your own five-clip movie and swap them for a double-feature night.

missions.title: Hold a paper-plane airshow
missions.supplies: A few sheets of paper and a cushion for a landing pad
missions.description: Fold one plane each, then compete for longest flight, best landing and most dramatic crash.
steps: Fold one paper plane each, using any design you like.
Event one: longest flight down a hallway or across a room.
Event two: land it on a cushion from three big steps away.
Event three: the most stylish crash, judged by your partner.
missions.finish: All three events are flown and a champion pilot has been crowned.
missions.apart: Fly your planes on a video call with the camera on the floor, and judge each other's flights.

missions.title: Play sock volleyball
missions.description: Keep a balled-up pair of socks in the air for as long as you can and try to beat your own record.
steps: Roll a clean pair of socks into a ball and clear some space.
Tap it back and forth, counting every hit before it touches the floor.
Add a new rule each round: elbows only, or name a fruit with every hit.
Write down your best streak somewhere you'll see it again.
missions.finish: You've played at least five rounds and set a record to beat.
missions.apart: Each keep your own sock ball up solo on a video call, take turns, and compare high scores.

missions.title: Adopt a mystery ingredient
missions.supplies: A small budget and a trip to a shop
missions.description: Buy one fruit, vegetable or snack neither of you has ever tried, and find out together whether it deserves a second visit.
steps: Go to a grocery store or market and pick one thing neither of you has tasted.
Look up the simplest way to eat or prepare it.
Taste it together and each describe it in exactly three words.
Vote on whether it's invited back.
missions.finish: You've tasted your mystery ingredient and voted on its future.
missions.apart: Each buy a new-to-you food from your own local shop and do the tasting live on a video call.

missions.title: Make something tiny look giant
missions.supplies: A phone and a small object
missions.description: Use a bit of camera trickery to turn a strawberry, a toy or a mug into a towering monster.
steps: Choose a small object and hold it close to the camera.
Have your partner stand far behind it and play along: running away, holding it up, taking a bite.
Shuffle around until the sizes line up just right.
Take three shots and swap roles.
missions.finish: You each have one photo where something tiny looks absolutely enormous.
missions.apart: Each make a giant-object photo in your own place and send it over for your partner to caption.

missions.title: Race through Wikipedia
missions.description: Start on the same random article and race to a target page using only the links on each page.
steps: Open a random article; that's your starting line.
Pick a target page together, like "Pancake" or "The Moon".
Race there by clicking only links inside articles, no search bar.
The winner reads out their route, then play best of three.
missions.finish: Three races are done and you've got a champion navigator.
missions.apart: Race on a video call and paste your routes into the chat when you finish.

missions.title: Pizza face-off
missions.supplies: Flatbreads or ready-made bases, sauce, cheese and toppings
missions.description: Each design a small pizza in secret, bake them side by side, and swap slices for blind judging.
steps: Each pick a theme for your pizza, like "breakfast" or "a vacation we loved".
Shop for or gather a few toppings without telling your partner your plan.
Build and bake your pizzas side by side.
Swap halves and score each one on taste, looks and theme.
missions.finish: Both pizzas have been judged and the losing chef has done the dishes.
missions.apart: Bake your pizzas in your own kitchens on a video call, then show and taste them on camera.

missions.title: Learn to juggle, badly
missions.supplies: Three pairs of rolled-up socks each
missions.description: Start with one rolled-up sock and work your way to three. The drops are half the fun.
steps: Toss one sock ball in an arc from hand to hand until it feels easy.
Add a second: throw it when the first one reaches the top of its arc.
Try all three and count how many catches you can make in a row.
Film your best attempt for the record.
missions.finish: You've each tried three and recorded a personal best.
missions.apart: Practice in your own rooms on a video call and cheer each other's best streaks.

missions.title: Five-clue object heist
missions.description: Secretly pick something in the room and drop clues one by one. Can your partner snatch it in five?
steps: Silently pick an object you can both see.
Give one clue at a time, starting vague ("it has been warm today").
Your partner gets one guess after each clue.
Swap roles and see who cracked theirs in fewer clues.
missions.finish: You've each pulled off one heist.
missions.apart: Pick objects you can both see on your video call, or describe something in your own room.

missions.title: Tabletop mini-golf
missions.description: Build three holes out of books and mugs, then flick a paper ball around the course.
missions.supplies: Paper, books, mugs and a cup for the hole
steps: Crumple a sheet of paper into a ball.
Build three holes on a table using books as walls and a cup lying on its side as the hole.
Take turns flicking the ball with one finger, counting each flick.
Fewest flicks over three holes wins.
missions.finish: You've played all three holes and tallied the scores.
missions.apart: Each build one hole in your own place, play both on a video call, and compare scores.

missions.title: Teach each other in twelve minutes
missions.description: Each teach the other one small thing you're good at, from a card trick to a perfect paper fold, in twelve minutes flat.
steps: Each pick one small skill you can actually teach in twelve minutes.
Set a timer and teach the first one; no taking over your student's hands.
Swap and learn the second one.
Show each other what you learned.
missions.finish: You've both shown off your new skill.
missions.apart: Teach over a video call with the camera pointed at your hands.

missions.title: Pack a care package from home
missions.description: Gather a few comforting things you already own into a box for someone who could use a little lift.
missions.supplies: A box or bag, paper and things from home
steps: Pick someone who's had a rough week.
Gather three to five things they'd like: a book you loved, tea, a drawing, a favorite snack.
Write them a short note together.
Drop it off or arrange to hand it over this week.
missions.finish: The package is packed and on its way to them.
missions.apart: Each put together a care package for someone in your own town and send each other a photo before it goes.

missions.title: Bottle up an ordinary day
missions.description: Write down the tiny details of today that future you will love remembering, like what's in the fridge and what everything costs.
steps: Each write down five small facts about today: what you ate, a song in your head, the weather, what bread costs.
Add one thing you hope is still true a year from now.
Fold the notes together and write a date one year from today on the outside.
Put it somewhere you won't lose it.
missions.finish: Today is sealed up and dated.
missions.apart: Write your notes separately, swap photos of them, and each keep both in a folder that opens in a year.

missions.title: Sentence from street signs
missions.description: Collect words from street signs and shop windows, then build the silliest sentence you can.
steps: Go for a short walk and photograph single words from signs, posters and shop windows.
Collect at least ten words between you.
Arrange them into the most ridiculous sentence possible.
Read it aloud like it's breaking news.
missions.finish: Your sentence has been read aloud with full drama.
missions.apart: Each collect words on your own street and build one sentence together by text.

missions.title: Pause and predict
missions.supplies: A movie or episode neither of you has seen, paper and a pen
missions.description: Stop a new movie halfway, write down secret predictions, and see who calls the ending.
steps: Pick something neither of you has seen.
Pause right around the middle.
Each write three predictions: a twist, who ends up happy, and one line someone will say.
Finish watching and give a point for every correct guess.
missions.finish: The credits have rolled and the best fortune-teller has been crowned.
missions.apart: Start the movie at the same moment on a call, pause together, write your predictions down and hold them up to the camera at the end.

missions.title: Popcorn seasoning lab
missions.supplies: Popcorn and a few spices or sweet toppings
missions.description: Split one batch of popcorn three ways and test three homemade seasonings until you find the house favorite.
steps: Make a batch of plain popcorn and split it into three bowls.
Each invent one seasoning from the spice rack, then make a third together.
Taste them blind, with your partner feeding you a piece from each bowl.
Name the winner and write the recipe on a scrap of paper.
missions.finish: You've crowned your official house popcorn.
missions.apart: Make popcorn at the same time on a video call, try the same three seasonings, and vote.

missions.title: Make a leaf field guide
missions.description: Sketch five different leaves you find on a walk, leave them where they are, and give each one a made-up name.
steps: Walk somewhere with trees or plants.
Find five leaves that look clearly different from each other.
Sketch each one without picking it.
Invent a name for each, like "Grumpy Maple", and a one-line fact.
missions.finish: Your five-leaf field guide is finished and named.
missions.apart: Each sketch leaves on your own walk and swap pages; see if any of your leaves match.

missions.title: Build a blanket-fort reading nook
missions.supplies: Blankets, pillows, chairs and something to read
missions.description: Drape blankets over chairs, pile in the pillows, and read side by side in your own tiny hideout.
steps: Drape blankets over chairs or a sofa to make a roof.
Fill the floor with pillows and add a light: a lamp, a flashlight or string lights.
Bring in something to read and a warm drink.
Read for twenty minutes, then read your favorite line out loud.
missions.finish: You've read inside the fort and shared a favorite line.
missions.apart: Each build a mini fort at home and read together on a video call from inside it.

missions.title: Judge a book by its cover
missions.supplies: A library card helps but isn't needed
missions.description: At a library or bookshop, each pick a book for the other based only on its cover, then read the first page aloud.
steps: Go to a library or bookshop.
Each secretly pick one book for your partner by cover alone: no blurbs.
Find a seat and read each other the first page out loud.
Decide if the cover told the truth.
missions.finish: You've read each other's first pages and judged the covers.
missions.apart: Pick a book cover for each other from an online library catalog and read the first pages on a call.

missions.title: Start a kitchen band
missions.supplies: Pots, spoons, a jar of rice or dried beans
missions.description: Turn pots, spoons and a jar of rice into instruments, then perform one song you both know.
steps: Each choose two kitchen instruments: a pot drum, a rice shaker, a spoon on a glass.
Pick a song you both know.
Practice one round, with one of you on beat and one on extras.
Perform it all the way through and record it.
missions.finish: Your kitchen band has recorded its debut performance.
missions.apart: Play along to the same song on a video call, each with your own kitchen instruments.

missions.title: Spaghetti and marshmallow tower
missions.supplies: Dry spaghetti, a bag of marshmallows, tape
missions.description: Build the tallest tower you can from dry spaghetti and marshmallows, with one marshmallow balanced on top.
steps: Each take twenty sticks of dry spaghetti and a handful of marshmallows.
Set a fifteen-minute timer and build.
When time's up, balance one marshmallow on top and let go.
Measure the tallest tower still standing.
missions.finish: Your towers are measured and the leftover marshmallows are eaten.
missions.apart: Build at the same time on a video call and measure with a ruler on camera.

missions.title: Open three mystery envelopes
missions.supplies: Paper and three envelopes or folded notes
missions.description: Each write ideas for a where, a what and a treat, seal them up, then let the envelopes plan your afternoon.
steps: Each write two ideas for a place, two for an activity and two for a small treat.
Put each kind in its own envelope and shuffle.
Draw one idea from each envelope without peeking.
Do whatever they say this afternoon.
missions.finish: You've done all three things the envelopes chose.
missions.apart: Draw your envelopes on a call and do the activity and treat in your own places at the same time.

missions.title: Name the neighborhood's paint colors
missions.description: Photograph five colors on a walk, then give each one a fancy paint-swatch name like "Bus Stop Teal".
steps: Take a short walk and photograph five colors that catch your eye.
Line the photos up like a row of paint swatches.
Give each one an absurdly fancy paint name.
Pick one you'd paint a room with.
missions.finish: You've named five colors and picked a favorite.
missions.apart: Each collect colors on your own walk and name each other's swatches.

missions.title: Make a snack stop-motion
missions.description: Film a cookie, a cracker or a pile of grapes slowly eating itself, one photo at a time.
steps: Set the snack on a plate and prop your phone so it can't move.
Take a photo, take one small bite or move one piece, then take another.
Repeat until the plate is empty, around twenty photos.
Flip through them fast or use a free stop-motion app to play it back.
missions.finish: Your snack has vanished on film, and in your stomachs.
missions.apart: Each make your own snack film and play them for each other on a call.

missions.title: Play homemade Taboo
missions.description: Help your partner guess a word without saying the three most obvious clues.
steps: Each write five words on slips, plus three banned words for each (for "beach": sand, sea, sun).
Swap slips without looking.
Take turns describing your words for one minute while avoiding the banned ones.
Count how many each of you got.
missions.finish: All ten words have been played.
missions.apart: Send each other your word lists privately and play on a video call.

missions.title: Toast topping tournament
missions.description: Invent three toast toppings, then run a proper bracket until one deserves a place on your breakfast table.
missions.supplies: Bread and whatever toppings you have
steps: Toast a few slices and cut them into small squares.
Each invent a topping using things in the kitchen; then make one together.
Taste them in head-to-head rounds.
Give the winner a proper name.
missions.finish: A champion toast has been named.
missions.apart: Make your toppings in your own kitchens on a call and judge each other's on looks and description.

missions.title: Solve a local mystery
missions.description: Pick one thing you walk past all the time, like a street name or an odd statue, and find out the story behind it.
missions.supplies: A phone or a trip to the library
steps: Each name one local thing you've always wondered about.
Pick one and dig in: look online, read a plaque, or ask someone who's lived there longer.
Find at least one surprising fact.
Go see it with your new knowledge, or tell the story the next time you pass.
missions.finish: You know the story behind one local mystery.
missions.apart: Each solve a mystery from your own town and tell the story on a call.

missions.title: Draw a best-of-our-area map
missions.description: Make a hand-drawn map of your favorite local spots for a friend, a visitor or a new neighbor.
steps: Pick who the map is for.
Sketch a simple map with your home base in the middle.
Add your five best spots, each with a one-line tip like "get the window seat".
Give it to them, or keep it for the next visitor.
missions.finish: The map is finished and has a home.
missions.apart: Each draw a map of your own area and swap them so you've got a guide to each other's world.

missions.title: Soundtrack this chapter of us
missions.description: Pick six songs that sum up right now, then put them in order like an album.
steps: Each pick three songs that feel like this season of your lives.
Explain each choice in one sentence.
Put all six in order and give the album a title.
Listen to it start to finish together.
missions.finish: Your six-song album has a title and has been played through.
missions.apart: Build the playlist in a shared music app and listen together on a call.

missions.title: Open a two-city art gallery
missions.description: Each make three tiny artworks on the same theme, hang them up, and give a video tour in your fanciest gallery voice.
steps: Agree on a theme, like "breakfast" or "us in ten years".
Each make three small artworks from whatever you have.
Tape them up on a wall with little handwritten labels.
Video call and give each other a guided tour, with very serious commentary.
missions.finish: Both galleries have had their grand opening.
missions.apart: Made for distance: give your tours by video, or send photos of each piece with an audio guide.

missions.title: Play neighborhood bingo
missions.supplies: Paper and a pen, or a notes app
missions.description: Fill in a bingo card with things like "a dog in a sweater" and "someone carrying flowers" on a walk.
steps: Each write eight things you might spot on a walk, from easy to unlikely.
Mix them into a grid and copy it so you both have one.
Walk and cross things off as you see them.
First to a full row picks the next snack.
missions.finish: Someone has shouted bingo.
missions.apart: Use the same card on separate walks and send photo proof of each find.

missions.title: Recreate an old photo
missions.supplies: An old photo and a phone
missions.description: Find a photo from years ago, of you as kids or from early in your relationship, and restage it as closely as you can.
steps: Pick an old photo of one or both of you.
Gather props and clothes that come close.
Match the pose, angle and facial expression as exactly as you can.
Put them side by side.
missions.finish: You've got a then-and-now pair worth keeping.
missions.apart: Each recreate a childhood photo of yourself and reveal them to each other at the same time.

missions.title: Cut a trailer starring a mug
missions.supplies: A phone and a household object
missions.description: Make a thirty-second movie trailer where a household object is the reluctant hero.
steps: Pick your star: a mug, a stapler, a slipper.
Film four short shots: ordinary life, the problem, the chase, the big moment.
Record a deep trailer voice: "In a world..."
Watch it with snacks.
missions.finish: Your trailer has premiered.
missions.apart: Each make a trailer for your own object and watch them back to back on a call.

missions.title: Blindfolded taste test
missions.supplies: A scarf or sleep mask and five small foods
missions.description: Take turns feeding each other mystery bites with your eyes closed and guess what they are.
steps: Each secretly pick five small bites from the kitchen, nothing either of you dislikes or is allergic to.
Blindfold your partner and feed them one at a time.
They guess each one and score a point for every correct answer.
Swap roles.
missions.finish: Ten bites have been tasted and guessed.
missions.apart: Each prepare your own plate, then guide each other by call: "take the second one from the left".

missions.title: Turn clouds into a comic
missions.description: Lie back, find shapes in the clouds, and turn the best three into a little comic strip.
steps: Find somewhere to lie or sit with a good view of the sky.
Take turns pointing out shapes in the clouds.
Pick three and sketch them as panels in a comic, adding speech bubbles.
Give your comic a title.
missions.finish: Your three-panel cloud comic is finished.
missions.apart: Each look at your own sky, send each other a shape you see, and draw the comic together panel by panel.

missions.title: Indoor floor picnic
missions.supplies: A blanket, snacks and something to watch
missions.description: Spread a blanket on the floor, set out picnic food, and eat while watching something you both love.
steps: Lay a blanket in the living room and add cushions.
Pack a picnic from the fridge, in a basket or bag for full effect.
Pick a show or movie and eat on the floor like it's a park.
missions.finish: The picnic has been eaten and the blanket folded.
missions.apart: Set up your own floor picnics and start the same show at the same time on a video call.

missions.title: Bakery mystery pick
missions.description: Each choose one thing from a bakery for the other without saying why, then share both on a bench.
steps: Find a bakery or café and head in together.
Each secretly buy one item for the other, without discussing it.
Find a bench and unveil your choices.
Explain your pick only after your partner has had the first bite.
missions.finish: Both treats are eaten and the reasons revealed.
missions.apart: Each pick something from a local bakery that you think your partner would love and eat it on a call.

missions.title: Name that intro
missions.description: Play the first five seconds of a song and see who names it first; bet points on how sure you are.
steps: Each pick five songs the other probably knows.
Play the first five seconds of each.
Before answering, bet one to three points on how sure you are.
Win the bet if you're right, lose it if you're wrong.
missions.finish: Ten songs have been played and points tallied.
missions.apart: Play intros for each other on a video call; it works fine with a little lag.

missions.title: Build a tilt maze in a box lid
missions.supplies: A box lid, paper, tape and a pen
missions.description: Make a maze with paper walls inside a shoebox lid, then race a paper ball through it by tilting.
steps: Draw a maze inside a box lid with a start and finish.
Glue or tape folded paper strips along the walls.
Roll a small ball of paper or foil through it by tilting the lid.
Time each other's runs.
missions.finish: Your maze works and you've both set a best time.
missions.apart: Each build a maze and swap the drawings; build your partner's design and race it on camera.

missions.title: Hunt through an online museum
missions.description: Browse a free museum collection online and find the weirdest, cutest and most mysterious objects.
steps: Pick a big museum with a free online collection.
Each search for three things: the weirdest object, the cutest, and the most mysterious.
Show each other your finds.
Choose one you'd travel to see in person.
missions.finish: You've shared six finds and picked one to see someday.
missions.apart: Browse separately and share your finds on a video call.

missions.title: Dress in one color for a day out
missions.description: Pick a color at random and dress in as much of it as you can for a little outing.
steps: Roll a die or pick a color out of a hat.
Each dress in as much of that color as you can find.
Go somewhere small: a walk, a café, the shops.
Take a matching photo.
missions.finish: You've been out in your color and have the photo to prove it.
missions.apart: Dress in the color in your own places and send photos or have a video coffee date.

missions.title: Write a receipt poem
missions.description: Make a poem using only words from a receipt, a cereal box or a junk-mail flyer.
missions.supplies: A receipt, packaging or flyer, and a pen
steps: Each grab some printed paper: a receipt, a box, a flyer.
Circle words and stitch them into a short poem.
Read your poems aloud with as much feeling as possible.
missions.finish: Both poems have been performed.
missions.apart: Write your poems separately and perform them on a call.

missions.title: Find the neighborhood's tiny wonders
missions.description: Hunt for the small things everyone walks past, like a door knocker or a cracked tile, and give each a museum plaque.
steps: Walk slowly and look for small things nobody notices.
Photograph five of them.
Write a grand plaque for each: name, year and why it matters.
Pick one to visit again.
missions.finish: Five tiny wonders have their own plaques.
missions.apart: Each hunt on your own streets and write plaques for each other's photos.

missions.title: Build a cardboard arcade game
missions.description: Turn old boxes into a playable game, like a ring toss, a coin slide or a skee-ball ramp.
missions.supplies: Cardboard boxes, tape, scissors and a pen
steps: Pick a game you can make from cardboard.
Cut and tape the parts together, with targets worth different points.
Play best of five rounds.
missions.finish: Your arcade game is built and the high score is on the box.
missions.apart: Each build a different game and play them over video, keeping score for each other.

missions.title: Invent new rock-paper-scissors moves
missions.description: Add two new moves to the old classic, decide what beats what, and play a full tournament.
steps: Each invent one new hand move with a name.
Decide together what it beats and what beats it.
Draw a chart so nobody can argue later.
Play best of nine.
missions.finish: Your new game has a chart and a champion.
missions.apart: Play on a video call; count down out loud and throw at the same time.

missions.title: Open a one-night restaurant
missions.description: Turn an ordinary meal into a themed pop-up with a menu, a name and a very attentive waiter.
missions.supplies: A meal you'd make anyway, paper and a pen
steps: Pick a theme: a seaside diner, a fancy bistro, a space station café.
Write a short menu with dramatic names.
One of you is the chef, the other is the waiter, and both of you are the guests.
Serve, eat and leave a glowing review.
missions.finish: Dinner has been served and reviewed.
missions.apart: Each run the restaurant for the other on video, serving yourselves the same meal.

missions.title: Meet one bird and one tree
missions.description: Get properly acquainted with one bird and one tree near you, well enough to greet them by name next time.
missions.supplies: A phone with a free plant or bird ID app, or a library book
steps: Pick one tree you pass often and one bird you see around.
Look closely: leaf shape, bark, the bird's colors and call.
Find out what they are and one surprising fact about each.
Give them nicknames as well as their real names.
missions.finish: You can both name your tree and your bird.
missions.apart: Each pick a tree and a bird near you, then introduce them to each other on a call.

missions.title: Send two surprise thank-yous
missions.description: Thank two people who'd never expect it, like an old teacher or the friendly bus driver, and tell them exactly why.
missions.supplies: Paper, a pen or your phone
steps: Each think of someone who helped you, long ago or this week.
Write a short, specific thank-you: what they did and what it meant.
Read each other your drafts.
Send, post or hand them over.
missions.finish: Both thank-yous are on their way.
missions.apart: Write yours separately and read them to each other on a call before sending.

missions.title: Document a date from two angles
missions.description: Go on a small outing and each take ten photos, then compare and see how differently you saw the same day.
steps: Head out somewhere simple: a walk, a market, a park.
Each take exactly ten photos without showing the other.
At home, lay both sets side by side.
Pick your favorite photo from your partner's set.
missions.finish: You've compared both sets and picked favorites.
missions.apart: Each take ten photos of your own day and swap; guess what your partner was feeling in each one.

missions.title: Take a street-view vacation
missions.description: Drop into a city neither of you has visited and guide each other to three landmarks using an online street map.
missions.supplies: A laptop or phone with an online map
steps: Pick a city neither of you has been to.
Each choose one landmark and one surprise spot, like a café or a weird statue.
On a video call, take turns guiding the other to your spots with street view.
Agree on one place you'd visit for real.
missions.finish: You've visited every spot and picked a real-life favorite.
missions.apart: Made for distance: share your screen and take turns driving.

missions.title: Guess the steps
missions.description: Pick a landmark up ahead, each guess how many steps it'll take to reach, and count out loud together.
steps: Point at something ahead: a tree, a lamppost, a corner.
Each guess how many steps it'll take.
Walk there in step with each other, counting out loud.
Closest guess wins a point; first to five wins.
missions.finish: Someone has five points and bragging rights.
missions.apart: Each pick landmarks on your own walk while on a voice call and guess each other's step counts.

missions.title: Photograph shadow creatures
missions.supplies: A flashlight or phone light and a few objects
missions.description: Use a flashlight and everyday objects to cast strange shadow animals on the wall, then name the species.
steps: Dim the lights and point a flashlight at a blank wall.
Combine hands, forks, plants and anything else into shadow creatures.
Photograph your three best.
Give each one a species name and a habitat.
missions.finish: You've discovered three new shadow species.
missions.apart: Make creatures in your own rooms and show them on a video call.

missions.title: Film a nature documentary at home
missions.description: Whisper-narrate the secret life of your houseplant, your pet or a very brave dust bunny.
steps: Choose your wildlife: a pet, a plant, a sleeping partner, a dust bunny.
Film three short clips of it "in the wild".
Record a hushed narration in your best nature-show voice.
Watch the finished film together.
missions.finish: Your documentary has had its screening.
missions.apart: Each film the wildlife in your own home and swap documentaries.

missions.title: Mug cake race
missions.supplies: Mugs, flour, sugar, cocoa, milk, oil and a microwave
missions.description: Mix a cake in a mug, microwave it, and see who can make the best one in under five minutes.
steps: Find a simple mug cake recipe and gather the ingredients.
Each add one secret extra: chocolate chips, cinnamon, a spoon of jam.
Mix and microwave one at a time.
Taste each other's and award prizes for flavor and fluffiness.
missions.finish: Both mug cakes have been tasted and judged.
missions.apart: Bake your mug cakes at the same time on a video call and describe each other's on camera.

missions.title: Find the oldest tree around
missions.description: Go looking for the biggest, oldest tree you can find nearby, then hug it to measure how big it really is.
steps: Walk somewhere with big trees: a park, an old street, a riverside path.
Pick the biggest trunk you can find.
Stretch your arms around it together and count how many hugs it takes.
Look up how old a tree that size might be.
missions.finish: You've found your old tree and guessed its age.
missions.apart: Each find the oldest tree near you and compare them on a call.

missions.title: Start a read-aloud book
missions.description: Pick a book and take turns reading chapters to each other, a little each night.
steps: Choose a book you'd both like: a mystery, a classic, something funny.
Get comfortable with blankets and a warm drink.
Take turns reading a few pages each, doing the voices if you dare.
Stop on a cliffhanger and mark your place.
missions.finish: You've read your first chapter together.
missions.apart: Read to each other on a phone call, ideally from bed.

missions.title: Two-stop snack showdown
missions.description: Each pick your favorite cheap snack spot nearby, visit both on one walk, and argue about which is better.
steps: Each choose one spot with a snack you swear by.
Walk to both and split each snack.
Score them on taste, value and atmosphere.
Crown the official best snack in the area.
missions.finish: Both snacks are eaten and one has been crowned.
missions.apart: Each buy your local favorite and eat it on a video call, then plan to swap spots when you visit.

missions.title: Film a lip-sync battle
missions.description: Pick a song, rehearse your best moves and facial expressions, then lip-sync it like you're headlining a stadium.
steps: Each pick a song for the other to perform.
Take ten minutes to rehearse, using props like a hairbrush mic.
Perform and film it start to finish.
Award trophies for drama, accuracy and best costume.
missions.finish: Both performances are filmed and the trophies awarded.
missions.apart: Perform for each other over video, or record and send your clips.

missions.title: Make a chair from one sheet of paper
missions.supplies: A few sheets of paper, scissors and a phone
missions.description: Fold, cut and roll a single sheet of paper into a tiny chair strong enough to hold a phone.
steps: Each take one sheet of paper; no tape or glue allowed.
Design and fold a chair in fifteen minutes.
Test it with a phone, then a heavier phone.
Name your chair like a fancy furniture brand.
missions.finish: Both chairs have been tested and named.
missions.apart: Build at the same time on video and test them live on camera.

missions.title: Visit a zoo on a live webcam
missions.description: Watch penguins, pandas or a sleepy bear on a live animal cam, and give everyone you see a name and a backstory.
steps: Find a free live animal webcam from a zoo or wildlife park.
Watch together for ten minutes.
Name every animal you see and invent their personalities.
Bookmark it and check back on your new friends later in the week.
missions.finish: Your new animal friends all have names.
missions.apart: Open the same webcam on a video call and narrate together.

missions.title: Invent a one-song dance
missions.description: Make up a short dance together to one song, including at least one move that makes you both laugh.
steps: Pick a song you both like.
Each invent two moves and teach them to the other.
Stitch them together and dance it through once.
Name your silliest move.
missions.finish: You've danced it start to finish.
missions.apart: Teach each other your moves over video and dance together on the call.

missions.title: Pick your official bench
missions.description: Test three benches, park seats or steps nearby and choose the one that's officially yours.
steps: Find three spots to sit near you.
Sit at each for five minutes and score the view, comfort and people-watching.
Pick a winner.
Agree on when you'll come back to it.
missions.finish: You've got an official bench.
missions.apart: Each find your own best bench and call each other from it.

missions.title: Paint one picture in turns
missions.description: Work on the same drawing or painting, swapping every two minutes, with no planning allowed.
missions.supplies: Paper and pens, pencils or paint
steps: Put one sheet of paper between you.
Set a two-minute timer; one person draws until it rings.
Swap and keep adding, taking it in whatever direction you like.
Stop after six rounds and give the artwork a title.
missions.finish: Your shared masterpiece has a title.
missions.apart: Use a free shared drawing app, or each draw on paper and send photos to continue.

missions.title: Host a two-minute radio show
missions.description: Grab three random objects and broadcast the day's "news" about them in your most serious voice.
missions.supplies: Three random objects and a phone to record
steps: Each grab three random objects.
Swap objects: these are your headlines.
Take turns reading two minutes of breaking news, weather and a traffic report.
Record it if you dare.
missions.finish: Both news bulletins have been broadcast.
missions.apart: Pick objects in your own rooms, show them on camera, and broadcast to each other.

missions.title: Make your partner's dream snack
missions.description: Each describe the perfect snack in detail, then the other tries to make it with what's in the kitchen.
steps: Each describe your dream snack in three sentences.
Make your partner's using only what you already have.
Present it with a straight face.
Score how close it came, out of ten.
missions.finish: Both dream snacks have been made and scored.
missions.apart: Swap descriptions by text, make them in your own kitchens, and do the tasting on a video call.

missions.title: Fix one broken thing
missions.description: Pick something you've meant to repair, like a wobbly chair or a missing button, and fix it together.
missions.supplies: Whatever the fix needs: thread, glue, a screwdriver
steps: Each name something small that's broken or annoying.
Pick one and watch a short how-to video if needed.
Fix it together, one of you holding and one of you doing.
Celebrate its second life.
missions.finish: One broken thing works again.
missions.apart: Each fix one thing in your own home on a video call, cheering each other on.

missions.title: Leave a book for a stranger
missions.description: Write a short note inside a book you loved and leave it somewhere for the next lucky reader.
missions.supplies: A book you're done with, paper and a pen
steps: Each choose a book you enjoyed and are ready to pass on.
Write a note inside the cover: why you loved it and who it might suit.
Leave it in a little free library, a café book swap or a charity shop.
missions.finish: Your books are out in the world.
missions.apart: Each leave a book in your own town and send a photo of where you left it.

missions.title: Record a voice postcard
missions.description: Send a one-minute voice note describing exactly where you are right now: the sounds, the light, the smell.
steps: Find a spot you like, inside or out.
Record one minute describing what you can see, hear and smell.
End with one thing that made you think of your partner today.
Send it, and listen to theirs.
missions.finish: You've both sent and listened to a voice postcard.
missions.apart: Perfect for distance: send them whenever you're somewhere worth sharing.

missions.title: Send a pocket parcel
missions.description: Bundle five little digital things from your corner of the world: a view, a sound, a song, a recipe and a word.
steps: Take a photo of a view you love near you.
Record a ten-second sound from your day.
Add a song, a simple recipe and one local word or saying.
Send all five together as one parcel and open theirs on a call.
missions.finish: You've each opened the other's parcel.
missions.apart: Made for distance: send it as one message thread.

missions.title: Scout film locations
missions.description: Walk around and find the perfect spots to shoot three scenes for an imaginary movie.
steps: Decide on a pretend movie: a heist, a romcom, a slow-burn mystery.
Walk and find locations for the opening, the big moment and the final scene.
Photograph each spot and act out a pose for it.
Pitch the whole film to each other.
missions.finish: You've scouted three locations and pitched your film.
missions.apart: Each scout locations in your own town for the same movie and combine them into one pitch.

missions.title: Shoot your band's album cover
missions.description: Invent a band, pose like rock stars, and make the album cover for your debut record.
steps: Pick a band name and a genre.
Set up a dramatic pose with props: a lamp, sunglasses, a houseplant.
Take ten shots and pick the best.
Write the track list on paper and hold it up for the back cover.
missions.finish: Your album has a cover and a track list.
missions.apart: Pose separately and put both photos side by side as the cover.

missions.title: Dub over a movie scene
missions.supplies: A movie or show and a phone to record
missions.description: Mute a scene from a movie and voice it with completely new lines.
steps: Pick a short scene with two characters talking.
Watch it once with sound, then mute it.
Each voice one character, inventing new lines as you go.
Record your best take.
missions.finish: You've recorded your own version of the scene.
missions.apart: Watch the scene in sync on a video call and each voice one character live.

missions.title: Invent a house drink
missions.supplies: Juice, tea, fruit, sparkling water or anything you have
missions.description: Mix juices, teas, fruit and fizzy water until you have a signature drink with a name.
steps: Gather a few drinks and flavorings you already have.
Each mix one small test drink in secret.
Swap and taste.
Combine the best bits into one house special and give it a name.
missions.finish: Your house drink has a recipe and a name.
missions.apart: Mix at the same time on video using whatever's in your own kitchens.

missions.title: Find a tiny world in the moss
missions.description: Get down low and look at a patch of moss or grass until you can see the tiny world inside it.
steps: Find a small patch of moss, grass or a mossy wall.
Look closely, or zoom in with your phone.
Imagine who lives there and what their town is like.
Take one close-up photo and tell its story.
missions.finish: You've discovered and described a tiny world.
missions.apart: Each find a mini world near you and swap the close-ups and stories.

missions.title: Make a ceiling of stars
missions.supplies: A colander or a box with holes poked in it, and a flashlight
missions.description: Shine a flashlight through a colander in a dark room and lie back under your homemade night sky.
steps: Turn off the lights and lie on the floor or bed.
Put a phone flashlight under an upside-down colander so it throws spots on the ceiling.
Name the new constellations you see.
Stay there and talk for a while.
missions.finish: You've named your own constellations.
missions.apart: Each make a star ceiling at home and lie under it on a voice call.

missions.title: Pick a piece to buy at a gallery
missions.description: Visit a free gallery or museum and each choose one artwork you'd take home if money were no object.
steps: Go to a free gallery, museum or local art show.
Wander separately for twenty minutes.
Each pick one piece you'd hang at home.
Show each other and explain where it would go.
missions.finish: You've each "bought" a piece.
missions.apart: Browse an online gallery separately and show each other your picks.

missions.title: Write each other a theme tune
missions.description: Hum, sing or tap out a short theme song for your partner, the kind that plays when they walk into a room.
steps: Each think of your partner's vibe: heroic, sneaky, sunny, dramatic.
Make up a ten-second tune by humming, whistling or tapping.
Add a couple of words if you like.
Perform it for them as they walk into the room.
missions.finish: You both have your own theme tune.
missions.apart: Record your tunes and send them as voice notes.

missions.title: Build a balloon-powered car
missions.supplies: A small bottle or cardboard, straws, bottle caps, skewers, tape and balloons
missions.description: Make a little car from a bottle, straws and bottle caps, then race it on balloon power.
steps: Make a body from a small bottle or a strip of cardboard.
Push skewers through straws for axles and attach bottle-cap wheels.
Tape a balloon to a straw at the back.
Blow it up, let go and race.
missions.finish: Your car has raced and the distance has been measured.
missions.apart: Each build a car and race them side by side on camera.

missions.title: Draw pixel-art portraits
missions.supplies: Grid paper and pens, or a free pixel-art app
missions.description: Draw each other on a sixteen-by-sixteen grid, like an old video game character.
steps: Draw a sixteen-by-sixteen grid, or open a pixel-art app.
Draw your partner one square at a time.
Add one detail that's unmistakably them.
Reveal them at the same time.
missions.finish: Both pixel portraits are finished and revealed.
missions.apart: Draw on your own and reveal them at the same moment on a call.

missions.title: Brand a boring object
missions.description: Design a very serious logo and slogan for something mundane, like your toaster or a sponge.
steps: Each pick a boring object in sight.
Give it a brand name, a logo and a slogan in three minutes.
Pitch it to your partner like they're an investor.
missions.finish: Both brands have been pitched.
missions.apart: Pitch to each other over a call.

missions.title: Visit the place you've always passed
missions.description: Finally go and see that park, shop or path you've walked past a hundred times and never visited.
steps: Each name a nearby spot you've always meant to check out.
Pick one and go.
Spend twenty minutes exploring it properly.
Decide if it's a new regular.
missions.finish: You've visited and given your verdict.
missions.apart: Each visit a place near you that you've always passed and share photos.

missions.title: Sculpt each other in foil
missions.description: Make tiny portrait statues of each other from kitchen foil, then display them like museum pieces.
steps: Tear off a big sheet of foil each.
Sculpt your partner in a typical pose: on the phone, asleep, mid-laugh.
Add one signature detail.
Display both statues and write a museum label.
missions.finish: Both statues are on display.
missions.apart: Sculpt on a video call and reveal your statues at the same time.

missions.title: Remix a game with one new rule
missions.description: Take a board or card game you know and add one wild rule, then see if it's better.
steps: Pick a game you both know.
Each suggest one new rule, like "switch hands every round".
Play one game with each rule.
Vote on which rule stays forever.
missions.finish: One house rule has been made permanent.
missions.apart: Play a card game over video with your own decks, or use a free online version.

missions.title: Cook a dish from your childhood
missions.description: Each teach the other a simple dish you grew up with, and write it on a recipe card to keep.
missions.supplies: Ingredients for two simple dishes and a card
steps: Each pick a simple dish from your childhood.
Cook them together, with the person who knows it in charge.
Write down each recipe, including any family tricks.
Eat while sharing a memory about each dish.
missions.finish: Both recipes are cooked and written down.
missions.apart: Cook along on a video call, each teaching your dish while the other follows.

missions.title: Learn to order in a new language
missions.description: Learn ten words in a language neither of you speaks, then role-play ordering at a café.
missions.supplies: A free language app or online phrase list
steps: Pick a language you're curious about.
Learn hello, please, thank you, the numbers one to three, and three foods.
Take turns being the café owner and the customer.
Order something real in that language next time you can.
missions.finish: You've ordered at least once in your new language.
missions.apart: Learn the words separately and role-play on a video call.

missions.title: Fifteen-minute litter pick
missions.description: Grab a bag and gloves and leave one familiar street, park or path a little nicer than you found it.
steps: Pick a spot that needs it.
Set a fifteen-minute timer.
Pick up as much litter as you can safely, skipping anything sharp.
Bin it and look back at the difference.
missions.finish: Fifteen minutes done and the bag is in the bin.
missions.apart: Each clean up near you at the same time and send a before-and-after photo.

missions.title: Write a letter to open next year
missions.description: Write a letter to the two of you, a year from now, then seal it up and pick a date to open it.
missions.supplies: Paper, a pen and an envelope
steps: Each write a short letter to the two of you a year from now.
Include what life is like today, what you're excited about and a guess about next year.
Seal both letters in one envelope.
Write the opening date on the front.
missions.finish: Your letters are sealed with a date on the front.
missions.apart: Write your letters separately and post them to each other, marked "Do not open until..."

missions.title: Direct each other's tiny film
missions.description: Your partner directs a one-minute silent film in your room, giving every instruction over video.
missions.supplies: A phone and a few props
steps: On a video call, the director picks three props they can see in your room.
They direct a one-minute silent scene: where to walk, what to do, when to react.
Film it, then swap roles.
Watch both films together.
missions.finish: Both films are shot and screened.
missions.apart: Made for distance: direct over a video call.

missions.title: Hand out front-door awards
missions.description: Take a walk and give awards to the best doors you pass: coziest, most mysterious, most likely to hide a wizard.
steps: Decide on five award categories.
Walk a street or two and look at every door.
Photograph a winner for each category.
Give an acceptance speech on each door's behalf.
missions.finish: All five awards have been given.
missions.apart: Each find winners in your own area and hold the awards ceremony on a call.

missions.title: Shoot a snack landscape
missions.supplies: Food, a plate and a phone
missions.description: Turn broccoli into a forest, rice into snow and crackers into cliffs, then take a photo that looks like a real place.
steps: Build a tiny landscape on a plate or board from food.
Add a tiny person or toy for scale if you have one.
Get your camera low and photograph it like a travel poster.
Name the place, then eat it.
missions.finish: Your landscape has been photographed, named and eaten.
missions.apart: Build landscapes separately and swap photos; guess what each part is made of.

missions.title: Act a scene in three genres
missions.description: Perform the same ten-second scene as a horror movie, a romcom and a nature documentary.
steps: Pick a tiny everyday scene, like finding the last cookie.
Perform it as a horror film.
Then as a romcom, then as a nature documentary.
Vote on the best genre.
missions.finish: All three versions are performed and voted on.
missions.apart: Perform for each other over video, or do one genre each and swap.

missions.title: Rank the pasta shapes
missions.supplies: Three pasta shapes and one sauce
missions.description: Cook three pasta shapes with the same simple sauce and settle once and for all which one is best.
steps: Cook a small handful of three different shapes.
Toss each with the same sauce.
Taste them side by side and rate them on bite, sauce grip and fun.
Crown a winner.
missions.finish: The pasta rankings are official.
missions.apart: Cook the same three shapes on a video call and compare rankings.

missions.title: Make bark rubbings
missions.description: Press paper against tree trunks and rub with a crayon to collect the patterns of different trees.
steps: Find a few different trees.
Hold paper flat against the bark and rub gently with the side of a crayon.
Collect three or four different patterns.
Label them and guess which tree each came from.
missions.finish: You've got a little collection of rubbings.
missions.apart: Each collect rubbings near you and swap photos to compare your trees.

missions.title: Learn a new card game
missions.description: Make a pot of tea, learn a two-player card game neither of you knows, and play until someone wins three.
steps: Look up a two-player card game you haven't played, like Speed or Gin Rummy.
Read the rules out loud together.
Play a practice round slowly.
Play for real until someone wins three.
missions.finish: You've learned a new game and someone has three wins.
missions.apart: Play a free online version together, or each use a deck and play a matching game on video.

missions.title: Shop a market lunch
missions.description: With a small budget each, buy one thing at a market, then put it all together into a picnic lunch.
steps: Find a local market or a good grocery store.
Each get a small budget and split up for ten minutes.
Buy one thing each that you think will go together.
Find a spot outside and assemble your lunch.
missions.finish: Your market lunch has been eaten.
missions.apart: Each shop your own local market and eat lunch together on a video call.

missions.title: Host living-room karaoke
missions.supplies: A phone or laptop and a hairbrush microphone
missions.description: Pull up karaoke versions of songs you love and sing your hearts out, no talent required.
steps: Find karaoke versions of songs online.
Each pick two songs for yourself and one for your partner.
Take turns performing, with the audience cheering loudly.
Finish with a duet.
missions.finish: You've sung your duet.
missions.apart: Sing to each other on a video call; take turns so lag doesn't spoil the duet.

missions.title: Make a string telephone
missions.supplies: Two paper cups, string and a pencil
missions.description: Connect two cups with a long piece of string and find out if you can really whisper through walls.
steps: Poke a small hole in the bottom of each cup.
Thread the string through and tie a knot inside each cup.
Pull the string tight and take turns talking and listening.
Test it around a corner, through a doorway and as quietly as possible.
missions.finish: You've had a whole conversation by string.
missions.apart: Each make one and test it with someone at home, then report back on whose worked better.

missions.title: Put yourselves in a famous painting
missions.supplies: A phone and things from around the house
missions.description: Pick a famous old painting and recreate it with yourselves as the stars, using props from home.
steps: Browse famous paintings online and pick one with one or two people in it.
Gather props and clothes that come close.
Pose and photograph yourselves to match.
Put the original and your version side by side.
missions.finish: Your masterpiece hangs next to the original.
missions.apart: Each recreate one figure from the same painting and combine the photos.

missions.title: Let a die pick your snack
missions.supplies: A die or a dice app and a little money
missions.description: Roll a die for the aisle and again for the shelf, and buy whatever you land on for a shared snack.
steps: Go to a grocery store with a small budget.
Roll for which aisle (count from the entrance), then roll for which shelf.
Pick the closest snack to where you land.
Eat it together and review it honestly.
missions.finish: The dice have chosen and the snack has been eaten.
missions.apart: Each roll for your own local shop on a call and taste your snacks together.

missions.title: Caption battle
missions.description: Pull three photos from your camera rolls and compete to write the best caption for each.
steps: Each pick three random photos from your camera roll.
Swap them and write one caption per photo.
Read them out and vote on the funniest.
missions.finish: All six photos have new captions.
missions.apart: Send the photos by text and read captions aloud on a call.

missions.title: Go on a mural hunt
missions.description: Find three murals, statues or bits of street art nearby and give each one a mini art review.
steps: Look up public art near you, or just wander and keep your eyes open.
Find three pieces.
At each one, each give it a star rating and a one-line review.
Take a photo of you two with your favorite.
missions.finish: Three pieces have been reviewed and a favorite chosen.
missions.apart: Each review art in your own town and swap photos and reviews.

missions.title: Invent a board game
missions.description: Design a tiny board game you can finish in ten minutes, then play it twice and fix the rules.
missions.supplies: Paper, pens and coins or buttons for pieces
steps: Draw a simple board: a path, a grid or a map.
Write no more than six rules, including one silly one.
Play a round and argue about what needs changing.
Fix one rule and play again.
missions.finish: Your game has been played twice and has a name.
missions.apart: Draw the same board on both ends, move pieces on camera and use a dice app.

missions.title: Draw what I describe
missions.description: Sit back to back while one of you describes a simple drawing and the other tries to copy it without peeking.
steps: One of you draws a simple picture in secret: a house, a monster, a mess of shapes.
Sit back to back and describe it step by step, using no names of objects.
Your partner draws only from your words.
Compare, laugh, swap.
missions.finish: You've each described and drawn one picture.
missions.apart: Describe over a voice call with cameras off, then reveal both drawings on video.

missions.title: Raid the international aisle
missions.description: Pick three snacks from a country you've never visited and have a taste-test trip without leaving town.
steps: Find the international aisle or a specialty shop.
Pick one country and buy three small snacks from it.
Taste them together and guess what's in each.
Look up one fact about the country while you snack.
missions.finish: You've tasted your way through three snacks.
missions.apart: Each buy snacks from the same country locally and taste them together on a call.

missions.title: Answer one big why question
missions.description: Each bring a question you've always wondered about, like why cats purr, and find the answer together.
steps: Each write down one "why" question you've never had time to look up.
Spend ten minutes researching each one.
Explain the answer to each other in under a minute, no notes.
Decide which answer was more surprising.
missions.finish: Both questions are answered and explained.
missions.apart: Research separately and teach each other on a call.

missions.title: Leave notes for everyday helpers
missions.description: Write little thank-you notes for the people who make your days easier, like a mail carrier or a cleaner.
steps: Make a list of people who quietly help you each week.
Each write two short, specific thank-you notes.
Leave them where they'll be found, or hand them over with a smile.
missions.finish: Your notes have been delivered.
missions.apart: Write notes for helpers in your own lives and tell each other how they were received.

missions.title: Start a quote jar
missions.description: Write down the funny, sweet and ridiculous things you say to each other and keep them in a jar.
missions.supplies: A jar or box, paper and a pen
steps: Find a jar or small box and decorate it a little.
Each write down three things your partner has said that you never want to forget.
Fold them up and drop them in.
Keep the jar where you'll remember to add to it.
missions.finish: Your jar has its first six quotes.
missions.apart: Keep a jar each, and read new quotes to each other on a call every few weeks.

missions.title: Draw your window view
missions.description: Each sketch the view from your window, swap drawings, and see each other's world through your eyes.
steps: Sit by a window and draw what you see for fifteen minutes.
Add one tiny detail your partner wouldn't know is there.
Swap photos of your drawings.
Guess what the hidden detail is.
missions.finish: You've swapped views and guessed the hidden details.
missions.apart: Made for distance: swap drawings by photo or post them.

missions.title: Window-shop for each other
missions.description: Stroll past shop windows and pick the perfect gift for your partner in every one, without buying a thing.
steps: Walk down a street with plenty of shops.
At each window, each point out the thing you'd get for the other.
Explain your choice in one sentence.
Keep a secret note of anything they really lit up about.
missions.finish: You've window-shopped a whole street.
missions.apart: Each walk your own shopping street on a video call and show your picks.

missions.title: Make a six-photo comic
missions.supplies: A phone and a free photo-editing app
missions.description: Act out a tiny story in six photos, then add speech bubbles to turn it into a comic strip.
steps: Plan a six-panel story: a quest, a mix-up, a rescue.
Act it out and take one photo per panel.
Add speech bubbles in an app or by printing and drawing.
Share it with someone who'll love it.
missions.finish: Your photo comic is finished.
missions.apart: Each shoot three panels in your own place and stitch them into one comic.

missions.title: Watch a movie from your birth year
missions.description: Each pick a well-loved film from the year you were born and make a double feature.
steps: Each look up popular films from your birth year.
Pick one you haven't seen and that the other would enjoy.
Watch them back to back, with a snack break in between.
Decide which year had better taste.
missions.finish: Both films are watched and a better year chosen.
missions.apart: Start each film at the same time on a call and chat between them.

missions.title: Shape rice-ball characters
missions.supplies: Cooked rice, plastic wrap and bits for faces
missions.description: Turn cooked rice into little characters with faces made from seaweed, peas or anything else you have.
steps: Cook some rice and let it cool enough to handle.
Use plastic wrap to shape it into balls, ovals or animals.
Add faces with seaweed, peas, carrot or sesame seeds.
Introduce your characters, then eat them.
missions.finish: Your rice characters have been introduced and eaten.
missions.apart: Shape characters in your own kitchens on a video call and hold a character show.

missions.title: Run a bee-and-butterfly watch
missions.description: Sit by some flowers for ten minutes and count every bee, butterfly and buzzing visitor that drops in.
steps: Find a patch of flowers on a warm day.
Sit a little way back so you don't disturb anyone.
Count every visitor for ten minutes, keeping a tally by type.
Pick the most charming visitor of the day.
missions.finish: You've done your count and named a favorite visitor.
missions.apart: Count at your own flowers at the same time and compare tallies.

missions.title: Make each other a word search
missions.description: Hide inside jokes, pet names and favorite places in a homemade word search for your partner to solve.
steps: Each pick eight words that mean something to you two.
Write them into a grid, forwards, backwards and diagonal.
Fill the gaps with random letters.
Swap and solve, with tea.
missions.finish: Both puzzles are solved.
missions.apart: Make yours and send a photo; solve on a printout or in an editing app.

missions.title: Ride a bus to the end of the line
missions.description: Hop on a local bus or train you never take and ride it all the way to see where you end up.
steps: Pick a route you've never taken.
Ride it to the last stop, window seat if you can.
Get off and explore for half an hour.
Find one thing worth coming back for, then head home.
missions.finish: You've reached the end of the line and found something good there.
missions.apart: Each ride a new route in your own city and send photos from the last stop.

missions.title: Change a scene's soundtrack
missions.supplies: A short movie clip and a music app
missions.description: Play the same silent movie clip with three different songs and see how it changes the whole mood.
steps: Pick a short scene, ideally without much dialogue.
Mute it and play it three times, each with a different song: sad, upbeat, scary.
Each guess what's happening in the scene with each soundtrack.
Pick the version that's funniest.
missions.finish: You've watched all three versions and picked your favorite.
missions.apart: Sync the clip on a video call and take turns playing the music.

missions.title: Build a house of cards
missions.supplies: One or two decks of cards
missions.description: Work as a team to build the tallest house of cards you can before it all comes tumbling down.
steps: Clear a flat table away from drafts.
Lean two cards together into a triangle and build a row.
Lay cards flat on top and keep building.
Count your levels before the collapse.
missions.finish: You've hit your highest level.
missions.apart: Each build your own tower on camera and compare heights.

missions.title: Run a two-film festival
missions.description: Each find one great free short film online, then hold a tiny festival with awards.
steps: Each search for a free short film under fifteen minutes.
Watch both together.
Award prizes for best twist, best character and best ending.
Pick one to send to a friend.
missions.finish: Both films are screened and the awards handed out.
missions.apart: Screen them in sync on a video call.

missions.title: Coin-flip picnic
missions.supplies: A coin, a blanket and some snacks
missions.description: Let coin flips decide every detail of a little picnic: where, what to eat and what to do.
steps: Write two options for each choice: location, food, game, music.
Flip a coin for every one, and follow the coin no matter what.
Pack up and head out.
Spend at least half an hour there.
missions.finish: The coin has planned a picnic and you've had it.
missions.apart: Flip for both of you on a call and have your picnics at the same time.

missions.title: Sixty-second list race
missions.description: Pick a category like "things that are yellow" and race to list as many as you can in one minute.
steps: Pick a category.
Each write as many answers as you can in sixty seconds.
Cross off any answer you both wrote.
Whoever has the most left wins the round.
missions.finish: Three rounds are played and someone's ahead.
missions.apart: Race on a call and read your lists aloud.

missions.title: Map a walk by sound
missions.description: Take a short walk and draw a map of what you hear, not what you see.
steps: Walk a short route slowly without headphones.
Stop every few minutes and listen for thirty seconds.
Draw a map with doodles for each sound: birds, a squeaky gate, laughter.
Pick the best sound on the map.
missions.finish: Your sound map is finished.
missions.apart: Each map a walk near you and swap maps; guess what each doodle is.

missions.title: Pass-the-comic
missions.description: Start a comic, stop on a cliffhanger, and hand it over to see where your partner takes it.
steps: Draw a simple four-box comic grid.
One person draws the first two panels, ending on a cliffhanger.
Hand it over for the next two panels.
Read it from the start together.
missions.finish: Your comic is finished and read aloud.
missions.apart: Send photos of your panels back and forth.

missions.title: Play the memory tray game
missions.description: Study a tray of twelve objects, close your eyes while one disappears, and guess what's missing.
missions.supplies: A tray and twelve small objects
steps: Gather twelve small, random things onto a tray.
Study it for thirty seconds.
Close your eyes while your partner takes one away or swaps two.
Guess what changed, then switch roles.
missions.finish: You've each played five rounds.
missions.apart: Show a tray on camera, turn the camera away to make your change, and let your partner guess.

missions.title: Chocolate tasting flight
missions.description: Line up three chocolates, from milk to very dark, and taste them slowly like you're very fancy judges.
steps: Break off a small piece of each.
Smell each one, let it melt, and describe the flavor in your own words.
Rank them from favorite to least favorite.
Agree on one to buy again.
missions.finish: All three are tasted and ranked.
missions.apart: Buy the same three bars and taste them together on a video call.

missions.title: Fold your first origami crane
missions.description: Follow a step-by-step guide and fold paper cranes together until you each have one you're proud of.
missions.supplies: Square paper and a how-to video
steps: Find a beginner crane tutorial.
Fold along together, pausing whenever one of you gets lost.
Fold a second one now that you know the steps.
Give your best crane to your partner.
missions.finish: You've each given away a crane.
missions.apart: Fold along to the same video on a call.

missions.title: Fill a donation bag
missions.description: Each find five things you no longer use but someone else would love, and drop them off together.
steps: Set a timer for twenty minutes.
Each find five things in good shape that you don't use: clothes, books, kitchen bits.
Tell the story of one item before it goes in the bag.
Drop the bag at a charity shop or donation point.
missions.finish: The bag has been dropped off.
missions.apart: Fill a bag each on a video call and send a photo when it's dropped off.

missions.title: Make a ninety-second film of how you met
missions.description: Retell the story of how you met in ninety seconds, with drawings, props or reenactments.
steps: Agree on the key moments of the story.
Pick a style: puppets, drawings, reenactment or narrated photos.
Film it in under ninety seconds.
Watch it together, then save it somewhere safe.
missions.finish: Your origin story is on film.
missions.apart: Each film half of the story, from your side, and stitch them together.

missions.title: Run a song relay
missions.description: Send a song, and your partner replies with a song that starts with the last word of its title.
steps: One of you sends a song.
The other replies with a song whose title starts with the last word of the first one's title.
Keep going for ten songs.
Save them all as a playlist.
missions.finish: Your ten-song chain is saved as a playlist.
missions.apart: Made for distance: play it by text over a day or two.

missions.title: Pick your dream house on a walk
missions.description: Stroll through a neighborhood and each claim the house you'd live in, then make your case.
steps: Walk a few residential streets.
Each keep an eye out for your dream house.
Claim it out loud and describe the life you'd live there.
Agree on one you'd share.
missions.finish: You've both picked a dream house and agreed on a shared one.
missions.apart: Walk on a video call and show each other your picks, or browse a dream town on street view.

missions.title: Shoot reflection portraits
missions.description: Photograph each other in reflections: puddles, shop windows, spoons, sunglasses.
steps: Look for three different reflective surfaces.
Take a portrait of each other in every one.
Try one where both of you appear in the reflection.
Pick your best one.
missions.finish: You've got your favorite reflection portrait.
missions.apart: Each take reflection selfies and swap them.

missions.title: Film something in reverse
missions.supplies: A phone with a reverse-video app
missions.description: Record a simple action, then play it backwards so it looks like magic.
steps: Plan an action that looks great backwards: jumping onto a sofa, unspilling a pile of paper, tossing on a hat.
Film it forwards, slowly and steadily.
Reverse it in an app.
Try three and keep the best.
missions.finish: You've got one reverse clip that looks like real magic.
missions.apart: Each film your own reverse trick and show them off on a call.

missions.title: Make homemade ice pops
missions.supplies: Juice, fruit, cups or molds and sticks or spoons
missions.description: Pour juice, fruit and yogurt into molds or cups, freeze them, and taste-test them tomorrow.
steps: Each design one flavor combination.
Pour into molds or small cups, adding chopped fruit if you like.
Add a stick or spoon and freeze overnight.
Taste tomorrow and pick a winner.
missions.finish: Your ice pops are frozen and tasted.
missions.apart: Make your own flavors and do the tasting together on a call the next day.

missions.title: Make a sundial
missions.supplies: A stick and a few pebbles
missions.description: Push a stick into the ground and mark its shadow every few minutes to watch time move.
steps: On a sunny day, push a straight stick into the ground.
Mark the tip of its shadow with a pebble.
Add a new pebble every ten minutes while you sit and chat.
Watch how far the shadow has traveled.
missions.finish: Your pebbles show the shadow moving.
missions.apart: Each make a sundial and send a photo when you've placed your last pebble.

missions.title: Tell a bedtime story in turns
missions.description: Make up a story together, one sentence at a time, until someone falls asleep or it reaches a happy ending.
steps: Lie down and get comfy.
One of you starts with "Once upon a time".
Take turns adding one sentence at a time.
Steer it gently to a happy ending.
missions.finish: Your story has an ending (or someone has fallen asleep).
missions.apart: Tell it on a phone call from bed.

missions.title: Have a sunrise date
missions.supplies: Warm layers and something hot to drink
missions.description: Set an alarm, bundle up, and watch the sun come up somewhere with a good view.
steps: Look up when sunrise is.
Find a spot nearby with an open view to the east.
Bring blankets and a warm drink.
Watch until the sun is fully up, then go get breakfast.
missions.finish: You've watched the sun come up.
missions.apart: Watch sunrise in your own places and send photos, or call each other for the moment it happens.

missions.title: Swap songs from when you were fifteen
missions.description: Each play three songs you loved at fifteen and tell the story of where you were when you heard them.
steps: Each pick three songs from around age fifteen.
Take turns playing them.
Share one memory for each.
Add the best ones to a shared playlist.
missions.finish: Six songs are shared and your playlist is started.
missions.apart: Play songs over a call or send them with voice notes about the memory.

missions.title: Race paper boats
missions.supplies: Paper, straws and a tub or bath with water
missions.description: Fold paper boats and race them across a tub or bath, powered only by blowing through a straw.
steps: Fold a paper boat each.
Fill a tub or bath with a little water.
Race your boats by blowing through a straw.
Best of five wins.
missions.finish: Five races done and a champion sailor crowned.
missions.apart: Race your own boats on camera and time each other.

missions.title: Pin our story on a map
missions.supplies: A laptop or phone with a free map app
missions.description: Make a shared online map with a pin for every place that matters to you two.
steps: Create a shared map in a free map app.
Each add five pins: where you met, first trips, favorite spots.
Write a line for each pin.
Add one pin for somewhere you want to go together.
missions.finish: Your map has at least eleven pins.
missions.apart: Build the map on a video call, each adding pins from your own device.

missions.title: Tongue-twister showdown
missions.description: Find three tricky tongue twisters and see who can say them fastest without falling apart.
steps: Each pick one tongue twister.
Say your partner's three times fast.
Try saying both together, in unison.
missions.finish: You've both tried, failed and laughed.
missions.apart: Do it on a call.

missions.title: Climb to the highest point nearby
missions.description: Find the highest spot you can walk to near you, a hill, a bridge or a tall public building, and take in the view.
steps: Look at a map and find the highest place you can reach on foot.
Walk or take the stairs to the top.
Point out three places you recognize from up there.
Take a photo of the view.
missions.finish: You've reached the top and spotted three landmarks.
missions.apart: Each climb to a high point near you and swap view photos.

missions.title: Fold a tiny zine
missions.description: Fold one sheet of paper into an eight-page mini magazine about something you both love.
steps: Look up how to fold an eight-page zine from one sheet.
Pick a topic: snacks, your city, your cat, your favorite show.
Fill the pages with drawings, lists and jokes.
Make a copy each.
missions.finish: Your zine is finished and copied.
missions.apart: Each make four pages and post or scan them to each other.

missions.title: Guide each other blindfolded
missions.description: Set up a soft obstacle course of pillows, then guide your blindfolded partner through it with only your voice.
missions.supplies: Pillows, a scarf and a clear room
steps: Build a soft course with cushions on the floor.
Blindfold one person.
Guide them through with directions only: "Two small steps left".
Swap and time each other.
missions.finish: You've both made it through.
missions.apart: Draw a paper maze, have your partner trace it with eyes closed while you guide by call.

missions.title: Cook a dish from a place you dream of
missions.description: Pick a country you'd love to visit and make one simple dish from there, then eat it while planning the trip.
steps: Each name a country you'd love to visit and pick one together.
