Find a simple traditional dish you can make.
Cook it together.
Eat while planning what you'd do there.
missions.finish: You've eaten your way to another country.
missions.apart: Cook the same dish on a video call and plan your dream trip over dinner.

missions.title: Invent a fix for a tiny annoyance
missions.description: Pick a small daily annoyance, like a cable that keeps falling, and invent a fix from things you have.
missions.supplies: Tape, string, clips and whatever's around
steps: Each name one small thing that annoys you daily.
Pick one and brainstorm three silly fixes and one real one.
Build the real one from things you own.
Test it for a week.
missions.finish: Your invention is installed and being tested.
missions.apart: Brainstorm on a call, then each build a fix for your own annoyance.

missions.title: Cook double and share
missions.description: Make a big batch of something comforting and take half to someone who could use a home-cooked meal.
missions.supplies: Ingredients for a big batch and containers
steps: Think of someone who's busy, unwell or just tired.
Cook something that keeps well, like soup or a pasta bake.
Pack a portion with a note.
Drop it off.
missions.finish: The meal has been delivered.
missions.apart: Each cook for someone in your own area and share photos of the handoff.

missions.title: Draw a postcard from our future
missions.description: Draw a postcard from a day you hope to have together someday, and write the back as if you're there.
steps: Each think of a future day you'd love together.
Draw the front of the postcard.
Write the back as if you're on that day right now.
Swap and pick one small step to make it more likely.
missions.finish: Both postcards are swapped and you've picked a first step.
missions.apart: Draw yours and post it to your partner for real.

missions.title: Plan one perfect hour of your next visit
missions.description: Design just one hour of your next time together, down to the snack and the song, so there's something real to look forward to.
steps: On a call, pick which hour of the visit you're planning.
Each suggest where you'll be, what you'll eat and what you'll do.
Write it up like an itinerary, minute by minute.
Pin it somewhere you'll both see it.
missions.finish: Your perfect hour is planned and pinned.
missions.apart: Made for distance: plan it in a shared note while you talk.

missions.title: Silly walk relay
missions.description: Take turns leading for one block in your silliest walk while the other copies exactly.
steps: Pick a quiet street or park path.
The leader invents a walk: penguin, tiptoe spy, runway model.
The follower copies it exactly for one block.
Swap leaders at every corner.
missions.finish: You've each led at least three walks.
missions.apart: Walk on a video call and copy each other's walks in your own streets.

missions.title: Three moods, one chair
missions.description: Use a single ordinary chair to shoot three totally different portraits: dramatic, sleepy and boss.
steps: Put a chair against a plain wall or in good window light.
Shoot three moods: dramatic, sleepy and big boss.
Use props and change the angle for each.
Pick one from each mood.
missions.finish: You've each got three portraits, one per mood.
missions.apart: Each shoot your own three-mood set and guess which mood is which.

missions.title: Film a love story between two objects
missions.description: Make a two-minute romance starring the salt and pepper shakers, or any two objects that belong together.
steps: Pick your lovers: salt and pepper, two socks, a cup and saucer.
Plan a meet-cute, a problem and a happy ending.
Film it in short clips, voicing the characters.
Watch it with popcorn.
missions.finish: Your love story has its happy ending.
missions.apart: Each voice one object over a video call, or film your own and swap.

missions.title: Fold dumplings together
missions.supplies: Dumpling wrappers, a filling and a pan
missions.description: Make a simple filling, learn two folds, and see who can make the neatest dumpling.
steps: Mix a simple filling from vegetables or whatever you like.
Watch a quick video for two folds.
Fold together, sharing tips and laughing at the wonky ones.
Cook them and award the neatest and the most creative.
missions.finish: Your dumplings are folded, cooked and eaten.
missions.apart: Fold along on a video call and compare plates.

missions.title: Regrow a kitchen scrap
missions.supplies: A vegetable scrap, a glass and water
missions.description: Put the root end of a green onion or lettuce in water and watch it grow back over the week.
steps: Save the root end of a green onion, lettuce or celery.
Stand it in a little water by a window.
Give it a name and take a photo every day.
Change the water every couple of days.
missions.finish: Your scrap has sprouted new growth.
missions.apart: Each grow one and send daily photos to see whose grows fastest.

missions.title: Rewatch a childhood favorite
missions.description: Each pick one episode of a show you loved as a kid and watch both together.
steps: Each pick an episode of a show you loved growing up.
Introduce it in one sentence: why it mattered to you.
Watch both together with snacks.
Decide which one has aged better.
missions.finish: Both episodes are watched.
missions.apart: Watch in sync on a video call.

missions.title: Cheer at a local amateur game
missions.description: Go watch a free local game, like a park league or a community match, pick a side and cheer like superfans.
steps: Find a free local game: a park match, a community league, a school team.
Pick a team to support before it starts.
Cheer loudly and invent a chant.
Give your own player-of-the-match award.
missions.finish: You've cheered through a whole game.
missions.apart: Each watch a local game and send each other the highlights.

missions.title: Learn a basic beatbox beat
missions.description: Learn the three basic beatbox sounds and put them together into your first real beat.
steps: Find a beginner beatbox video.
Practice the kick ("b"), the hi-hat ("t") and the snare ("pf").
Put them in order: b-t-pf-t.
Record one of you beatboxing while the other raps or hums.
missions.finish: You've recorded your first beat.
missions.apart: Practice on a video call and record a duet.

missions.title: Build a bird feeder from a carton
missions.supplies: An empty carton, scissors, string, a stick and birdseed
missions.description: Turn an empty milk or juice carton into a bird feeder and hang it where you can watch the visitors.
steps: Rinse a carton and cut a window in two sides.
Poke a stick through below the windows as a perch.
Fill the bottom with birdseed and tie string to the top.
Hang it somewhere you can see from a window.
missions.finish: Your feeder is hung and waiting for guests.
missions.apart: Each build a feeder and report your first visitors.

missions.title: Find your places from space
missions.supplies: A laptop or phone with a satellite map
missions.description: Quiz each other with satellite views of places that matter to you two. Can you guess where it is?
steps: Each pick five places that matter: a childhood home, a first date spot, a favorite park.
Zoom in on each one in satellite view.
Show your partner without the labels and let them guess.
Share the story of each place.
missions.finish: All ten places are guessed and their stories told.
missions.apart: Share your screen on a video call and take turns.

missions.title: Have a three-yes afternoon
missions.description: Each get to ask for three small things this afternoon, and the answer has to be yes.
steps: Agree on the rules: small, kind, free, and doable today.
Each make three requests: a walk, a song, pancakes.
Take turns making them happen.
Say which yes was your favorite.
missions.finish: All six yeses have happened.
missions.apart: Make requests that work from afar, like a song, a call or a drawing.

missions.title: Blind portrait drawing
missions.description: Draw each other while looking only at your partner's face, never at the paper.
steps: Sit face to face.
Set a one-minute timer.
Draw your partner without looking down once.
Reveal at the same time.
missions.finish: You've revealed both portraits (and laughed).
missions.apart: Draw each other from a video call.

missions.title: Find the alphabet outside
missions.description: Hunt for letters hiding in branches, cracks, fences and shadows, and try to collect A to Z.
steps: Look for shapes that look like letters, not actual signs.
Photograph each one you find.
Try to get the letters of both your names first.
Spell something with your collection.
missions.finish: You've spelled at least one word in found letters.
missions.apart: Each hunt near you and combine your letters into one message.

missions.title: Make a paper lantern
missions.supplies: Paper, scissors and a battery tea light
missions.description: Cut a pattern into paper, wrap it around a battery tea light, and make your room glow.
steps: Draw a simple pattern on paper: stars, waves, leaves.
Cut out the shapes carefully.
Roll the paper into a tube and tape it.
Pop it over a battery tea light and turn off the lights.
missions.finish: Your lantern is glowing.
missions.apart: Each make a lantern and turn off the lights on a video call to compare.

missions.title: Play tabletop coin shuffleboard
missions.description: Slide a coin across the table toward paper targets and see who can land it closest without falling off.
steps: Tape three paper targets at the far end of a table, worth 1, 3 and 5 points.
Take turns sliding a coin from the edge.
Coins that fall off score zero.
First to twenty-one wins.
missions.finish: Someone has twenty-one points.
missions.apart: Set up the same targets at home and play on camera.

missions.title: Make a dip trio
missions.description: Make three quick dips from whatever's in the kitchen, then go around with crackers and veggies to find a favorite.
steps: Each make one quick dip from what you have: yogurt and herbs, mashed beans, salsa.
Make a third one together.
Taste them with crackers and vegetables.
Write down the winner's recipe.
missions.finish: Three dips are made and one is crowned.
missions.apart: Make dips on a video call and describe them in great detail.

missions.title: Learn three useful knots
missions.supplies: A piece of rope or string each
missions.description: Learn a bowline, a square knot and a clove hitch, then test them on something real.
steps: Look up a simple video for each knot.
Learn one each, then teach it to the other.
Learn the third together.
Test them by tying up a bag, a plant or a shoelace.
missions.finish: You can both tie all three knots.
missions.apart: Learn together on a video call with your own rope.

missions.title: Make a book of favor coupons
missions.description: Make each other little coupon books of favors, like "one free back scratch" or "I'll pick the movie".
steps: Cut paper into coupon-sized pieces.
Each write five favors you'd happily give.
Decorate and staple them into a little book.
Swap books and use one this week.
missions.finish: You've swapped books and used your first coupon.
missions.apart: Write favors that work from afar, like "one long call", and post them.

missions.title: Write the same memory separately
missions.description: Each write down the same shared moment without peeking, then compare what you each remembered.
steps: Pick one shared memory: a trip, a first, a funny disaster.
Each write it down for ten minutes.
Read them aloud to each other.
Notice the details only one of you kept.
missions.finish: You've read both versions.
missions.apart: Write yours separately and read them on a call.

missions.title: Cook the same recipe at the same time
missions.supplies: Ingredients for one recipe and a phone stand
missions.description: Pick one recipe, cook it in your own kitchens on a video call, then eat dinner together across the distance.
steps: Choose a simple recipe you can both get ingredients for.
Prop up your phones and start a video call.
Cook step by step together.
Eat together and rate the dish.
missions.finish: You've cooked and eaten the same meal together.
missions.apart: Made for distance: cook and eat on video.

missions.title: Get a little lost on purpose
missions.description: Walk out the door and alternate left and right at every corner, then see where you end up.
steps: Start at your door.
Turn left at the first corner, right at the next, and keep alternating.
Stop at the first interesting thing you find.
Use your phone to find your way back.
missions.finish: You've found somewhere new and made it home.
missions.apart: Each do the walk on a voice call and describe where you land.

missions.title: Take a paper friend on a trip
missions.supplies: Paper, pens, scissors and a phone
missions.description: Draw and cut out a little paper character, then take photos of it out in the world.
steps: Draw a small paper character and cut it out.
Give it a name and a personality.
Take it with you for the day and photograph it in five places.
Write a caption for each.
missions.finish: Your paper friend has five travel photos.
missions.apart: Each make a friend and post it to the other; send photos of its adventures.

missions.title: Make a silent movie with title cards
missions.description: Shoot a two-minute silent film with dramatic acting and handwritten title cards between scenes.
steps: Plan a tiny plot: a lost sandwich, a mysterious knock.
Write three title cards, like "Meanwhile..."
Film your scenes with very big expressions.
Add the title cards and some piano music.
missions.finish: Your silent film has premiered.
missions.apart: Each film half the story and stitch them together.

missions.title: Build a no-bake dessert sandwich
missions.description: Sandwich something sweet between two cookies or crackers and see whose creation is the best.
steps: Gather cookies or crackers.
Each create one sandwich with a filling: jam, nut butter, banana, chocolate.
Chill them for ten minutes.
Taste and vote.
missions.finish: Both dessert sandwiches have been eaten.
missions.apart: Make them at the same time on a video call.

missions.title: Rate the sunset
missions.description: Head somewhere with a view, watch the sun go down, and give it a serious score out of ten.
steps: Find out when sunset is.
Find a spot with a clear view west.
Watch the whole thing without phones, except for one photo.
Each give it a score and a one-line review.
missions.finish: The sunset has been reviewed.
missions.apart: Watch your own sunsets, send photos and score each other's.

missions.title: Have a side-by-side project night
missions.description: Each pick a half-finished project and work on it side by side with snacks and music.
steps: Each pick a project you've abandoned: knitting, a sketch, a puzzle.
Put on a playlist and make snacks.
Work side by side for an hour.
Show each other your progress at the end.
missions.finish: You've each made real progress.
missions.apart: Work on a video call with your projects on camera.

missions.title: Pick a plant for each other
missions.description: Visit a plant shop or nursery and each choose a small plant for the other that matches their personality.
steps: Go to a plant shop, nursery or market stall.
Each secretly choose a small plant for the other.
Explain why it suits them.
Name your new plants together.
missions.finish: You each have a new plant with a name.
missions.apart: Each choose a plant for your partner and send it, or buy your own and introduce them on a call.

missions.title: Rewrite the lyrics
missions.description: Take a song you both know and rewrite the words about your week, then perform it.
steps: Pick a famous song with a simple chorus.
Rewrite the chorus about something from your week.
Write one verse each.
Sing it through.
missions.finish: Your rewritten song has been performed.
missions.apart: Write it in a shared doc and perform it on a video call.

missions.title: Design your dream tiny house
missions.description: Draw the floor plan for a tiny house you'd love to share, with one ridiculous luxury.
steps: Agree on how small the house is: one room, two rooms, a treehouse.
Take turns adding rooms, furniture and windows.
Each add one ridiculous luxury.
Decide where it would be in the world.
missions.finish: Your dream house plan is finished.
missions.apart: Draw it together in a free online whiteboard.

missions.title: Do a free online escape room
missions.description: Find a free browser escape room and solve the puzzles together before time runs out.
steps: Search for free online escape rooms and pick one.
Agree on roles: one clicks, one keeps notes.
Solve the puzzles together.
Celebrate when you escape.
missions.finish: You've escaped.
missions.apart: Share your screen and solve it on a video call.

missions.title: Thrift a treasure for each other
missions.description: With a tiny budget, each hunt a thrift shop for the perfect small treasure for the other.
steps: Go to a thrift or charity shop.
Split up and set a fifteen-minute timer.
Each find a small treasure that reminds you of your partner.
Swap them and explain your choice.
missions.finish: You've each got a new treasure.
missions.apart: Each thrift something for the other and post it.

missions.title: Invent a secret handshake
missions.description: Make up a handshake with at least five moves that only the two of you know.
steps: Each suggest two moves: a fist bump, a spin, a wiggle.
Add one move together.
Practice until you can do it without thinking.
missions.finish: You can do your handshake perfectly.
missions.apart: Make up a matching air handshake you can do on camera.

missions.title: Turn your street into a postcard
missions.supplies: A phone and a photo-editing app
missions.description: Find the most postcard-worthy view near home and make a "Greetings from..." postcard.
steps: Walk around and find the most charming view near you.
Photograph it like it's a travel destination.
Add "Greetings from..." in big letters.
Send it to a friend.
missions.finish: Your postcard has been sent.
missions.apart: Each make a postcard of your own area and send it to each other.

missions.title: Make friendship bracelets
missions.supplies: Embroidery thread or yarn and tape
missions.description: Weave simple bracelets in colors that mean something to you, then tie them on each other.
steps: Pick three colors each that remind you of your partner.
Tape the threads to a table and follow a simple braid.
Make one for each other.
Tie them on.
missions.finish: You're both wearing your bracelets.
missions.apart: Make bracelets on a video call and post them to each other.

missions.title: Play alphabet conversation
missions.description: Have a conversation where each sentence starts with the next letter of the alphabet.
steps: Pick a scene: two spies, a fancy dinner, a pirate ship.
The first sentence starts with A, the next with B.
Get through to Z without hesitating too long.
missions.finish: You made it to Z.
missions.apart: Play on a call.

missions.title: Build a sandwich in turns
missions.description: Take turns adding one layer each to the same sandwich until it's a masterpiece or a disaster.
steps: Start with one slice of bread.
Take turns adding one layer each, without vetoes.
Stop at six layers and add the top slice.
Cut it in half and eat together.
missions.finish: Your sandwich has been eaten.
missions.apart: Each build a sandwich in turns on a call, adding the layer your partner picks.

missions.title: Learn one constellation
missions.description: Learn to spot one constellation, then go outside after dark and find it together.
steps: Pick a constellation visible right now.
Learn its shape and the story behind its name.
Head outside on a clear night and find it.
Pick one star in it to be yours.
missions.finish: You've found it in the sky.
missions.apart: Look for it at the same time on a call; check whether you can both see it.

missions.title: Fold encouraging fortunes
missions.description: Write tiny notes of encouragement, fold them up, and leave them for friends, coworkers or strangers.
steps: Each write five short encouraging notes.
Fold them into tiny squares or paper stars.
Leave them where people will find them: a library book, a noticeboard.
Keep one each for yourselves.
missions.finish: Your fortunes are out in the world.
missions.apart: Write notes for your own neighborhoods and send photos of where you left them.

missions.title: Press a flower from today
missions.supplies: A flower, paper and a heavy book
missions.description: Pick up a fallen flower or buy one on your walk, press it in a heavy book, and label it with today's date.
steps: Find a fallen flower or leaf, or buy a single bloom.
Lay it between two pieces of paper inside a heavy book.
Write today's date and one line about the day.
Check it in a week.
missions.finish: Your flower is pressing.
missions.apart: Press flowers from your own walks and post them to each other.

missions.title: Send real mail
missions.supplies: Paper, an envelope and a stamp
missions.description: Write and post each other an old-fashioned letter, with a small surprise tucked inside.
steps: Write a letter about your week and something you love about your partner.
Tuck something small inside: a drawing, a pressed leaf, a ticket stub.
Post it.
Open your partner's letter on a call.
missions.finish: You've both opened your letters.
missions.apart: Made for distance: post it.

missions.title: Play park hide-and-seek
missions.description: Head to a park and play hide-and-seek like you're eight years old.
steps: Pick a park with some trees or bushes.
Agree on boundaries.
One hides while the other counts to thirty.
Play five rounds, swapping each time.
missions.finish: You've both hidden and both been found.
missions.apart: Play a photo version: take a picture of where you're hiding at home and see if your partner can guess.

missions.title: Take a portrait without your face
missions.description: Make a self-portrait that's unmistakably you, using only your hands, shoes and favorite things.
steps: Gather three things that are very you.
Arrange them with your hands or feet in the frame.
Photograph it without your face.
See if your partner can guess what each object means.
missions.finish: You've both taken and decoded a portrait.
missions.apart: Swap photos and guess the meanings on a call.

missions.title: Film an epic tutorial
missions.description: Make a dramatic step-by-step tutorial for something very ordinary, like making toast.
steps: Pick a very ordinary task.
Film three steps with dramatic music and close-ups.
Narrate it like it's the most important skill in the world.
Watch it back.
missions.finish: Your tutorial is finished.
missions.apart: Each film a tutorial and swap.

missions.title: Give leftovers a makeover
missions.description: Turn last night's leftovers into a totally different lunch, then argue about which was better.
steps: Look at what's left over.
Brainstorm three ways to transform it: wraps, fried rice, soup.
Pick one and cook it.
Score it against the original.
missions.finish: Your makeover meal has been eaten.
missions.apart: Each transform your own leftovers on a call.

missions.title: Fly a homemade kite
missions.supplies: Paper or a plastic bag, two sticks, tape and string
missions.description: Make a simple kite from paper, sticks and string, then take it somewhere windy.
steps: Look up a simple diamond-kite design.
Make the frame, cover it and add a tail.
Head to an open space on a breezy day, away from trees and power lines.
Get it up and keep it up.
missions.finish: Your kite has flown.
missions.apart: Make kites on a video call and send videos of your flights.

missions.title: Set up a hot-chocolate bar
missions.description: Make a pot of hot chocolate and set out toppings, from marshmallows to cinnamon, for the coziest evening.
steps: Make a pot of hot chocolate.
Set out toppings in little bowls.
Each build a mug for the other.
Drink them under a blanket.
missions.finish: You've had a mug each.
missions.apart: Make your own and drink together on a video call.

missions.title: Try a free event you'd normally skip
missions.description: Find a free local event outside your usual taste, like a poetry reading or a model train show, and go with open minds.
steps: Search local listings for free events this week.
Pick one neither of you would normally go to.
Go and stay for at least half an hour.
Each share one thing you liked.
missions.finish: You've been and shared a highlight.
missions.apart: Each go to a free event near you and swap stories.

missions.title: Throw a decade dance party
missions.description: Pick a decade at random and dance in the kitchen to its biggest hits.
steps: Pick a decade by drawing slips or rolling a die.
Make a ten-song playlist from that decade.
Dance to every song, matching the moves to the era.
Crown the best dancer.
missions.finish: You've danced through the playlist.
missions.apart: Dance on a video call to the same playlist.

missions.title: Build a pencil catapult
missions.supplies: Pencils, rubber bands, a plastic spoon and marshmallows
missions.description: Make a tiny catapult from pencils and rubber bands, then fire marshmallows into a cup.
steps: Look up a simple pencil catapult.
Build it with pencils, rubber bands and a spoon.
Set a cup across the table.
Take turns firing and count the hits.
missions.finish: Your catapult works and someone has scored.
missions.apart: Build them on a video call and compete on camera.

missions.title: Play an online drawing game
missions.description: Join a free online draw-and-guess game, just the two of you, and find out who's secretly great at drawing.
steps: Find a free online draw-and-guess game with private rooms.
Create a room and invite each other.
Play three rounds.
Screenshot the funniest drawing.
missions.finish: Three rounds done and the best drawing saved.
missions.apart: Play from your own devices on a call.

missions.title: Give a tour of your life
missions.description: Take your partner on a guided tour of a place from your everyday life or your past, with stories at every stop.
steps: Pick a place full of your stories: your old street, your daily route, your school.
Plan four stops.
At each one, tell the story like a professional tour guide.
Let your partner ask one question per stop.
missions.finish: The tour is finished and the guide has been tipped with a hug.
missions.apart: Give the tour on a video call while walking, or use street view.

missions.title: Squiggle challenge
missions.description: One of you draws a random squiggle and the other turns it into a picture.
steps: Each draw a random squiggle on a page.
Swap pages.
Turn the squiggle into a picture in two minutes.
Give it a title.
missions.finish: Both squiggles are now masterpieces.
missions.apart: Send squiggles by photo and reveal pictures on a call.

missions.title: Go on a texture hunt
missions.description: Take a walk and find the softest, roughest, bumpiest and smoothest things you can touch.
steps: Make a list: softest, roughest, bumpiest, smoothest, coldest.
Walk and test things with your hands (gently, nothing alive).
Photograph the winner of each category.
Vote on the strangest find.
missions.finish: All five categories have winners.
missions.apart: Hunt near your own homes and swap photos and descriptions.

missions.title: Make art from what's in a drawer
missions.supplies: A junk drawer and a phone
missions.description: Empty a junk drawer and arrange the buttons, coins and odds and ends into a picture.
steps: Tip out a junk drawer or gather small objects.
Pick a subject together: a face, a landscape, a creature.
Arrange the objects on a table to make it.
Photograph it, then put everything back.
missions.finish: Your temporary artwork has been photographed.
missions.apart: Each make one from your own junk drawer and guess what's used in each other's.

missions.title: Invent a secret code
missions.description: Create a code only the two of you can read, then send each other a secret message.
steps: Make a key: a symbol for each letter, or a shift like A becomes D.
Copy the key so you both have it.
Each write a short secret message.
Swap and decode.
missions.finish: Both messages are decoded.
missions.apart: Share the key on a call, then send coded messages all week.

missions.title: Hold a tea tasting
missions.supplies: Three kinds of tea and three cups each
missions.description: Brew three different teas, taste them side by side and describe them like experts.
steps: Brew three different teas.
Smell each one first and guess the flavor.
Taste and describe each in three words.
Pick a favorite.
missions.finish: All three are tasted and one is crowned.
missions.apart: Brew the same teas and taste together on a call.

missions.title: Learn to fingerspell your names
missions.supplies: A free online guide or video
missions.description: Learn the sign language alphabet for your local sign language and spell your names to each other.
steps: Look up the fingerspelling alphabet for your local sign language.
Each learn the letters in your own name.
Teach your name to your partner.
Try spelling a short word the other has to read.
missions.finish: You can both spell both names.
missions.apart: Learn together on a video call.

missions.title: Make a bookmark for a book you love
missions.description: Lend a friend a favorite book with a handmade bookmark that tells them why they'll love it.
steps: Each pick a book you love and a friend who'd enjoy it.
Cut a bookmark from card.
Write why they'll love it and decorate it.
Lend or give the book.
missions.finish: Your books are on their way.
missions.apart: Do it for friends in your own towns and share photos of the bookmarks.

missions.title: List your year of firsts
missions.description: Write down all the firsts from this past year, big and small, from first trips to first terrible haircut.
steps: Each write as many firsts from this year as you can in ten minutes.
Read them out and add any the other forgot.
Star the three best.
Keep the list somewhere safe.
missions.finish: You've got a full list of firsts.
missions.apart: Write lists in a shared note on a call.

missions.title: Go on a synced walk
missions.description: Walk at the same time in your own neighborhoods on a call, and narrate everything you see to each other.
steps: Pick a time and start a call.
Both head out for a walk.
Take turns describing what you see.
Send each other one photo from the walk.
missions.finish: You've walked together across the distance.
missions.apart: Made for distance: walk and talk on a call.

missions.title: Chalk a sidewalk message
missions.description: Draw a cheerful chalk message on a sidewalk or path for strangers to find.
steps: Pick a spot where chalk is welcome, like your own path or a public sidewalk.
Decide on a message: "You're doing great" or "Look up!"
Draw it with pictures and color.
Watch for someone to smile at it.
missions.finish: Your message is out there.
missions.apart: Each chalk a message in your own town and send photos.

missions.title: One photo, two stories
missions.description: Take one photo that tells completely different stories depending on how you crop it.
steps: Set up a scene with a few things happening.
Take one photo.
Crop it two ways to tell two different stories.
Show your partner the crops first, then the full picture.
missions.finish: Both crops have been revealed.
missions.apart: Each take one and reveal on a call.

missions.title: Make foley sound effects
missions.supplies: A movie clip and household objects
missions.description: Mute a short movie clip and redo every sound effect yourselves using household objects.
steps: Pick a short clip with lots of action.
Mute it and list every sound needed.
Find objects to make each sound: footsteps, doors, rain.
Perform the sound live as you play it.
missions.finish: You've performed the whole clip.
missions.apart: Each perform sounds for the same clip on a video call.

missions.title: Make soup with a topping bar
missions.description: Make one big pot of simple soup, then set out bowls of toppings so everyone builds their own.
steps: Make a simple soup: tomato, lentil or vegetable.
Set out toppings: herbs, croutons, seeds, chili, a swirl of yogurt.
Each build two bowls.
Taste each other's best combo.
missions.finish: Soup has been made and eaten.
missions.apart: Cook the same soup on a call and compare toppings.

missions.title: Hunt for patterns in nature
missions.description: Look for spirals, stripes and symmetry in leaves, shells, flowers and pine cones.
steps: Head somewhere green.
Look for spirals, stripes, symmetry and branching.
Photograph one example of each.
Pick the most beautiful pattern.
missions.finish: You've found four kinds of pattern.
missions.apart: Hunt near your own homes and compare finds.

missions.title: Do a jigsaw puzzle together
missions.description: Put on a playlist, make tea and work on a jigsaw puzzle side by side.
steps: Pick a puzzle, borrowed or dug out of a cupboard.
Do the edges first.
Divide areas or work together on one.
Take a photo of your progress.
missions.finish: You've done at least half the puzzle.
missions.apart: Do the same free online jigsaw together.

missions.title: Visit a farm or petting zoo
missions.description: Spend an afternoon saying hello to goats, sheep and chickens at a city farm or petting zoo.
steps: Find a city farm, petting zoo or farm with visiting hours.
Go together.
Each pick a favorite animal and give it a nickname.
Take a photo with it.
missions.finish: You've met your favorite animals.
missions.apart: Each visit a farm near you and send photos of your new friends.

missions.title: Make a playlist for your partner's week
missions.description: Pick one song for each day of your partner's week, matched to what they've got coming up.
steps: Ask your partner what's coming up this week.
Pick one song for each day.
Add a short note for each.
Send the playlist.
missions.finish: Both playlists are sent.
missions.apart: Swap playlists by link.

missions.title: Make a balancing bird
missions.supplies: Cardboard, scissors, tape and two coins
missions.description: Cut a bird from cardboard, add coins to its wingtips, and balance it on the tip of your finger.
steps: Find a balancing-bird template online.
Cut it out of cardboard.
Tape a coin under each wingtip.
Balance it on a fingertip, a pencil and a nose.
missions.finish: Your bird balances.
missions.apart: Make birds on a video call and balance them on camera.

missions.title: Tell a story in emoji
missions.description: Send each other a story told in only twelve emoji, then retell your partner's story out loud.
steps: Each write a short story in twelve emoji.
Swap.
Retell your partner's story out loud.
The author reveals what it was meant to be.
missions.finish: Both stories are told.
missions.apart: Send by text and retell on a call.

missions.title: Two truths and a lie
missions.description: Tell three facts about yourself, one false. Can your partner find the lie?
steps: Each think of two true things and one lie.
Take turns sharing.
Guess the lie, then hear the stories behind the truths.
missions.finish: You've each tried to fool the other.
missions.apart: Play on a call.

missions.title: Race to a meeting point
missions.description: Pick a spot nearby, take different routes there, and see who arrives first.
steps: Pick a spot about fifteen minutes away.
Each choose a different route and start at the same time.
Take one photo on the way.
Swap photos when you meet.
missions.finish: You've both arrived and swapped photos.
missions.apart: Each walk to a spot near you and see who gets there first.

missions.title: Make a magazine collage
missions.supplies: Old magazines or flyers, scissors and glue
missions.description: Cut up old magazines and flyers to make a collage of your dream week.
steps: Gather old magazines and flyers.
Pick a theme: dream week, our future, perfect food.
Cut out pictures and words.
Glue them into a collage.
missions.finish: Your collage is finished.
missions.apart: Make collages on a call and show them off.

missions.title: Living-room bowling
missions.supplies: Six bottles and a pair of rolled socks
missions.description: Set up water bottles as pins and roll a pair of socks to see who bowls a strike.
steps: Fill bottles with a little water and set them up.
Roll your sock ball from across the room.
Play five frames each.
Do a victory dance.
missions.finish: Five frames done and a champion crowned.
missions.apart: Set up your own lanes and bowl on camera.

missions.title: Breakfast for dinner
missions.description: Make pancakes, eggs or whatever breakfast you love for dinner, with candles and a fancy table.
steps: Each pick one breakfast dish.
Cook them together.
Set the table like a fancy restaurant.
Eat while sharing your favorite breakfast memory.
missions.finish: Breakfast dinner is eaten.
missions.apart: Cook on a video call and eat together.

missions.title: Learn a magic trick
missions.supplies: A coin, cards or a rubber band
missions.description: Each learn one simple trick from a video, practice it, and perform it for the other.
steps: Each find a beginner magic trick video.
Practice for fifteen minutes.
Perform it.
Decide whether to reveal the secret.
missions.finish: Both tricks are performed.
missions.apart: Perform on a video call.

missions.title: Volunteer for an hour
missions.description: Find a local group that needs a hand, like a food bank or park clean-up, and give an hour together.
steps: Look up local volunteer opportunities.
Sign up for an hour that suits you both.
Go together.
Talk about what you saw on the way home.
missions.finish: You've given your hour.
missions.apart: Each volunteer near you and share stories on a call.

missions.title: Hall of fame for bad photos
missions.description: Dig up your blurriest, worst photos of each other and give them gallery titles.
steps: Each find five of your worst photos.
Give each one a grand title, like "Portrait of a Sneeze, Mid-Arrival".
Present them like a museum tour.
Save the best in a shared album.
missions.finish: Your hall of fame has been curated.
missions.apart: Swap photos and do the tour on a call.

missions.title: Photograph the sky at the same minute
missions.description: Pick a time, look up at the same moment wherever you are, and send each other your skies.
steps: Agree on a time.
At that minute, step outside and photograph the sky.
Send your photos to each other.
Describe the sky in one sentence.
missions.finish: You've swapped skies.
missions.apart: Made for distance: swap photos.

missions.title: Draw a chalk hopscotch
missions.supplies: Sidewalk chalk and a small stone
missions.description: Chalk a hopscotch grid on a sidewalk or path and see who can still do it without wobbling.
steps: Find a quiet sidewalk or path.
Draw a hopscotch grid.
Take turns hopping.
Add a silly rule each round.
missions.finish: You've both completed the grid.
missions.apart: Each chalk a grid and film your hops.

missions.title: Shoot from the ground and the sky
missions.description: Photograph the same scene from flat on the ground and from as high up as you safely can.
steps: Pick a scene: a tree, a bike, a cup of coffee.
Lie down and shoot it from below.
Stand on a step and shoot it from above.
Compare how the two feel.
missions.finish: You've got both views.
missions.apart: Each shoot a scene and swap.

missions.title: Remake a famous movie scene
missions.description: Recreate one iconic movie scene in under a minute using cardboard, blankets and whatever's lying around.
steps: Pick one famous scene.
Make props from cardboard, blankets and kitchen stuff.
Rehearse once and film it.
Watch the original and your version back to back.
missions.finish: Your remake is filmed.
missions.apart: Each film half the scene and edit them together.

missions.title: Quick-pickle something
missions.supplies: Vegetables, vinegar, sugar, salt and a jar
missions.description: Slice up a vegetable, pour over hot vinegar and spices, and have homemade pickles by dinner.
steps: Slice cucumber, carrot, onion or radish.
Heat vinegar with a little sugar, salt and spices.
Pour it over the vegetables in a jar.
Let it cool and taste in an hour.
missions.finish: Your pickles are ready.
missions.apart: Pickle on a video call and taste together.

missions.title: Take a night nature walk
missions.description: Walk somewhere safe and familiar after dark and listen for owls, insects and the night.
steps: Pick a safe, familiar path.
Walk slowly after dark.
Stop twice and listen for a full minute.
Name everything you hear.
missions.finish: You've heard the night.
missions.apart: Each walk your own night path on a call.

missions.title: Write a book-spine poem
missions.description: Stack books so the titles on their spines read like a poem.
steps: Pull books off the shelf.
Stack them so the titles read like a poem.
Photograph the stack.
Read it aloud.
missions.finish: Your poem is stacked and read.
missions.apart: Make your own stacks and read them on a call.

missions.title: Plan a dream room at a furniture store
missions.description: Wander through a furniture store and design your dream room together, without buying a thing.
steps: Go to a big furniture or home store.
Pick a room to design: a reading nook, a kitchen.
Choose every piece and take photos.
Pick your favorite thing in the store.
missions.finish: Your dream room is designed.
missions.apart: Browse a furniture site on a call and build a dream room together.

missions.title: Listen to a whole album, lights off
missions.description: Turn off the lights, lie down and listen to a whole album start to finish, no phones.
steps: Each suggest an album and pick one.
Lie down with the lights off.
Listen start to finish without talking.
Share your favorite song.
missions.finish: You've listened to the whole thing.
missions.apart: Press play at the same moment and listen together on a call.

missions.title: Build a marble run from tubes
missions.supplies: Cardboard tubes, tape and a marble
missions.description: Tape cardboard tubes to a wall or door and build a marble run that takes as long as possible.
steps: Save cardboard tubes and cut some in half lengthwise.
Tape them to a wall or door in a zigzag.
Drop a marble in and time the run.
Tweak it to make it slower.
missions.finish: Your marble run works.
missions.apart: Build runs on a video call and race them.

missions.title: Make a montage of your month
missions.supplies: A phone with a free video app
missions.description: Pick your best clips and photos from the month and turn them into a one-minute video.
steps: Each pick ten photos or clips from this month.
Put them in order.
Add a song.
Watch it together.
missions.finish: Your montage is made and watched.
missions.apart: Make it in a shared album and watch it on a call.

missions.title: Hold a living-room Olympics
missions.supplies: Socks, spoons, a cup and paper medals
missions.description: Run five silly events, like sock toss and spoon balance, and award medals.
steps: Plan five events: sock toss, spoon balance, slow-motion race.
Compete in each.
Keep score.
Make paper medals and hold a ceremony.
missions.finish: Medals are awarded.
missions.apart: Compete on a video call.

missions.title: Make thumbprint creatures
missions.supplies: Paper, pens and a washable marker or ink pad
missions.description: Press five thumbprints onto paper and turn each one into a tiny character with legs, ears and a name.
steps: Color your thumb with a marker and press five prints onto paper.
Swap pages and turn your partner's prints into creatures.
Give each one a name and a single-word personality.
missions.finish: Ten little creatures have names.
missions.apart: Make prints, swap photos, and doodle on them in an editing app or on printouts.

missions.title: Explore a neighborhood you've never walked
missions.description: Pick a nearby neighborhood neither of you knows and wander it for an hour, with no plan beyond finding one great spot.
steps: Find a neighborhood on the map you've never walked through.
Get there and wander without directions for forty minutes.
Each point out one thing you'd come back for.
Stop for a rest at the best spot you found.
missions.finish: You've explored it and picked a reason to return.
missions.apart: Each explore a new area near you on a voice call, describing your finds as you go.

missions.title: Build a tiny house for a tiny creature
missions.description: Gather fallen twigs, leaves and pebbles and build a little house at the foot of a tree for an imaginary resident.
steps: Collect fallen bits only: twigs, bark, leaves, pebbles.
Build a tiny house at the base of a tree, with a door and a path.
Add one luxury, like a leaf hammock or pebble patio.
Name its resident and photograph the house.
missions.finish: Your tiny house has a resident and a photo.
missions.apart: Each build a house near you, swap photos and write the residents' life stories.

missions.title: Play movie charades
missions.description: Act out movie titles with no words, just wild gestures, and see who can guess the most before time runs out.
steps: Each write five movie titles on slips and swap.
Take turns acting one out in silence for up to a minute.
Score a point for every correct guess.
Play a final round with titles the other has to act in slow motion.
missions.finish: All the titles have been acted out.
missions.apart: Send titles by private message and act them out on a video call.

missions.title: Apple taste-off
missions.description: Buy three kinds of apple (or pears, or grapes) and taste them side by side to find out which is really best.
steps: Pick up three varieties of the same fruit.
Slice them and hide the labels.
Taste each one and score it on crunch, sweetness and juiciness.
Reveal the names and crown a winner.
missions.finish: The fruit has been tasted and ranked.
missions.apart: Buy the varieties your local shops have and compare scores on a call.

missions.title: Learn to spot three clouds
missions.description: Learn three cloud types, like cumulus, cirrus and stratus, and then find them in the sky this week.
steps: Look up three common cloud types and what makes each one different.
Learn one fact about the weather each one usually brings.
Head outside and find at least one in the sky today.
Check the sky every day this week and name what you see.
missions.finish: You've spotted all three types.
missions.apart: Send each other cloud photos all week and quiz each other on the type.

missions.title: Review a small local business
missions.description: Write a glowing, detailed review for a small local spot you love. It means more to them than you'd think.
steps: Each pick a small local business you love: a café, a bakery, a repair shop.
Write a review that names one specific thing they do well.
Read each other your reviews.
Post them, and tell the owner next time you're in.
missions.finish: Both reviews are posted.
missions.apart: Each review a favorite spot in your own town and read them out on a call.

missions.title: Tell your day in three objects
missions.description: Pick three objects that sum up your day and use them to tell your partner how it really went.
steps: Each gather three objects that sum up today: a receipt, a mug, a pen.
Lay them out in order.
Tell the story of your day through them, one object at a time.
Your partner picks which object told the best story.
missions.finish: You've both told your day in objects.
missions.apart: Show your objects on a video call and tell the stories.

missions.title: Guess the close-up
missions.description: Take extreme close-up photos of things at home and see if your partner can guess what they are.
steps: Each take five extreme close-ups of things in your home.
Send them one at a time.
Your partner gets three guesses per photo, with a hint after each wrong one.
Reveal the full photo after each round.
missions.finish: All ten close-ups are guessed or revealed.
missions.apart: Made for distance: play by text or on a video call.

missions.title: Initials hiding in plain sight
missions.description: Hunt your neighborhood for both your initials hiding in railings, cracks and branches. Real letters don't count.
steps: Walk a loop you know well and look for shapes that form your initials: a bent pipe, a forked twig, a crack in the sidewalk.
Signs, graffiti and printed letters are off limits.
Snap your best match for every letter.
Line the photos up to spell both sets of initials and vote on the most convincing letter.
missions.finish: Every letter of both your initials has a found-shape photo.
missions.apart: Each hunt for both sets of initials on your own walk, then trade photos and pick the best letter from each place.

missions.title: Luxury launch for a sponge
missions.supplies: A phone, a lamp, and a dark towel or T-shirt
missions.description: Shoot a humble household object like it's the most expensive thing ever made: moody light, slow reveal, ridiculous tagline.
steps: Pick something humble: a spoon, a sponge, a single sock.
Drape a dark cloth behind it and light it from one side with a lamp.
Take three shots: a tight detail, a dramatic angle, and the hero shot.
Write a one-line tagline worthy of a billboard.
missions.finish: Your hero shot has a tagline and you both agree it looks wildly overpriced.
missions.apart: Each launch a different object, swap photos and taglines, and guess what the other's 'product' would cost.

missions.title: Worst commercial ever made
missions.supplies: A phone and any household object
missions.description: Film a 30-second ad for a product whose big selling point is completely useless.
steps: Choose an object and invent its terrible feature, like a mug that only holds cold soup.
Write three lines: the problem, the product, the slogan.
Film it with full infomercial energy, smiling right into the camera.
Add a super-fast 'terms and conditions' voiceover at the end.
missions.finish: Your ad is filmed, disclaimer and all.
missions.apart: Each film an ad for something in your own home, then watch both on a call and award 'Least Convincing Pitch'.

missions.title: Make each other's breakfast
missions.description: Swap breakfast duty and make each other's usual morning order exactly the way they like it.
steps: Each give a one-minute briefing: how you take your toast, eggs, cereal, coffee or tea.
No follow-up questions once the briefing is over.
Make each other's breakfast at the same time, side by side.
Score the result out of ten and give one tip for next time.
missions.finish: You've both eaten a breakfast made by the other and handed out scores.
missions.apart: Send your briefing as a voice note, then each make the other's breakfast on a video call and eat it as if you were them.

missions.title: Three nights of moon sketches
missions.description: Spend five quiet minutes at a window after dark sketching the moon, or the sky where it's hiding.
steps: Find a window, balcony or doorstep with a patch of night sky.
Sketch the moon's shape, or the clouds and lights if it's hiding.
Jot down the time, one sound you can hear and one word for the mood.
Do it again on two more nights this week and line the sketches up.
missions.finish: You have three moon sketches side by side.
missions.apart: Each sketch your own sky and swap photos of your pages; it's extra fun if one of you can see the moon and the other can't.

missions.title: Read me your favorite page
missions.description: Pick one page from a book you love, read it aloud, and find out which line your partner would underline.
steps: Each choose one page from any book you love or are reading right now.
Read it aloud slowly, boring bits included.
The listener names the one line they'd underline.
The reader explains why they picked that page.
missions.finish: Both pages have been read and both lines chosen.
missions.apart: Read to each other over a call with the lights low, then text the line that stuck.

missions.title: Mural story walk
missions.description: Visit two pieces of public art and invent one story that starts at the first and ends at the second.
steps: Find two murals, statues or sculptures within walking distance of each other.
At the first one, decide who the characters are and what just happened.
Walk to the second and work out how the story ends there.
Tell the whole tale out loud on the way home.
missions.finish: Your story has a beginning at one artwork and an ending at the other.
missions.apart: Each pick one artwork near you, send a photo, and build the story together in voice notes.

missions.title: Keep the beat in the silence
missions.description: Clap along to a song, mute it mid-chorus, and find out who's still on the beat when it comes back.
steps: Pick a song with a steady beat and clap along together.
One of you mutes it without warning; keep clapping.
Unmute after about ten seconds and hear who drifted.
Do three songs, making the silence a little longer each time.
missions.finish: Three songs done and you know who has the better inner metronome.
missions.apart: Each record yourself clapping through a muted stretch of the same song, then swap clips and judge who stayed on time.

missions.title: Two-sheet paper bridge
missions.supplies: Paper, two books, a handful of coins
missions.description: Build a bridge from one sheet of paper each and see whose holds the most coins before it caves in.
steps: Set two books about a hand's width apart.
Each fold, roll or pleat one sheet of paper into a bridge. No tape.
Add coins to the middle one at a time until it collapses.
Steal one idea from each other's design and try again.
missions.finish: Both bridges have been tested twice and one holds the record.
missions.apart: Build at the same time on a video call and count the coins out loud.

missions.title: First lines from free classics
missions.description: Read the opening paragraphs of three free classic books online and vote on which one you'd actually finish.
steps: Open a free public-domain library like Project Gutenberg.
Between you, pick three titles you've never read, chosen for their names alone.
Read each other just the first paragraph of each, out loud.
Vote on a winner and read one more page of it.
missions.finish: You've heard three openings and crowned a winner.
missions.apart: Paste the links in your chat and take turns reading over a call.

missions.title: One hour of yes
missions.description: For one hour, take turns suggesting small, kind, doable things and the other has to say yes.
steps: Set a timer for an hour and agree on the rules: free, safe and nearby.
Take turns proposing something: a song to dance to, a snack, a lap around the block, a silly accent.
The other says yes and joins in properly.
Swap who suggests every ten minutes until the timer rings.
missions.finish: The hour is up and you've each said yes at least three times.
missions.apart: Do it on a video call with ideas you can each do at home, like 'go find the strangest mug you own.'

missions.title: Air orchestra
missions.description: Perform a famous piece of music using only your voices, hands and extremely serious faces.
steps: Pick a tune you both know, like a movie theme.
Split the orchestra: one does strings and drums, the other brass and the big cymbal crash.
Perform it start to finish with full air-conducting.
Take a bow, then record the encore if you dare.
missions.finish: The whole piece has been performed and a bow has been taken.
missions.apart: Perform it over video, then take turns being the orchestra and the audience.

missions.title: Find it without looking
missions.description: Lead your partner to a nearby spot using only clues about how it sounds, smells or feels.
steps: One of you picks a spot within a few minutes' walk: a bakery vent, a fountain, a rough brick wall.
Give clues only about sound, smell or texture. Nothing about how it looks.
The other leads the way and can ask yes-or-no questions.
Swap roles once the spot is found.
missions.finish: You've each found the other's secret spot.
missions.apart: Describe a spot near you without saying what it looks like; your partner guesses, then you reveal it with a photo.

missions.title: Paper stained-glass window
missions.supplies: Colored or tissue paper, a black marker, scissors, glue or tape
missions.description: Make a stained-glass panel from colored paper and tape it where the sun comes through.
steps: Draw a bold design with thick black outlines: a bird, a sun, your initials.
Fill each section with a different color of paper.
Tape it to a window.
Look at it again when the light is low and golden.
missions.finish: Your window is up and you've seen the light come through it.
missions.apart: Make one each and send a photo of it glowing; mail them to each other later if you like.

missions.title: What changed on the tray?
missions.supplies: A tray and ten small objects
missions.description: Study ten objects for thirty seconds, look away, and spot what your partner sneakily changed.
steps: Put ten small things on a tray.
Your partner studies it for thirty seconds, then turns around.
Remove, swap or move one or two things.
They name what changed. Swap roles and make each round harder.
missions.finish: You've each played three rounds.
missions.apart: Play over video with objects on your own table; the person holding the camera makes the change.

missions.title: Roll your own rice-paper rolls
missions.supplies: Rice paper wrappers, sliced veggies, herbs, a dipping sauce
missions.description: Soak rice paper wrappers, fill them with crunchy veggies and herbs, and see who can roll the neatest one.
steps: Slice cucumber, carrot and any other crunchy veggies into thin sticks.
Dip a wrapper in warm water for a few seconds until it softens.
Lay fillings in the middle, fold in the sides and roll it up tight.
Compare your neatest and messiest rolls, then dip and eat.
missions.finish: You've each rolled at least three and eaten them.
missions.apart: Roll on a video call and hold up your best roll for judging.

missions.title: Paper helicopter test flights
missions.description: Fold paper helicopters, drop them from a height, and figure out what makes them spin and fall slowest.
steps: Cut a strip of paper, split the top half into two blades and fold them in opposite directions.
Clip a paperclip to the bottom.
Drop both from the same height and see whose lands last.
Change one thing each round: longer blades, two clips, no clip.
missions.finish: You've found your slowest-falling design.
missions.apart: Build on a video call and drop them on the count of three.

missions.title: Skill coupons
missions.description: Give each other a coupon for something you're genuinely good at, from braiding hair to fixing a squeaky door.
steps: Think of one thing you're good at that your partner would actually use.
Design a little coupon: what it's for, plus some silly fine print.
Hand it over with a flourish.
Agree on when it'll be redeemed.
missions.finish: Both coupons are exchanged and each has a redemption date.
missions.apart: Send a photo of your coupon and redeem it over video, like a cooking lesson or a playlist makeover.

missions.title: Front page of an ordinary day
missions.description: Publish a one-page newspaper about today, with breaking news, a weather report and a tiny classified ad.
steps: Pick today's lead story, however small: 'Local Couple Finds Matching Socks.'
Add a weather report, a quote of the day and one classified ad.
Draw a little photo in a box.
Date it, sign it and keep it somewhere safe.
missions.finish: Your front page is finished and filed away.
missions.apart: Each report on your own day and swap front pages by photo or mail.

missions.title: Coach me through the camera
missions.description: One of you builds something simple while the other coaches by voice alone, no hands on the project.
steps: The builder picks a simple task: a paper airplane, a card tower, a folded box.
The coach gives step-by-step instructions by voice only.
The builder does exactly what they're told, no improvising.
Test the result, then swap roles with a new task.
missions.finish: Both builds are finished and tested.
missions.apart: Made for distance: just prop up your phones so the coach can see the builder's hands.

missions.title: I spy, no repeats
missions.description: Take turns naming things you notice on a walk, with no repeats allowed. It gets hard fast.
steps: Walk any short route together.
Take turns naming one thing you see: 'a green door,' 'a cat in a window.'
Nothing can be named twice, and you get ten seconds per turn.
Whoever gets stuck first loses; the winner is crowned Chief Noticer and picks the next song.
missions.finish: Someone has been stumped and the Chief Noticer is crowned.
missions.apart: Play on a call while you each walk your own streets.

missions.title: Same shape, different worlds
missions.description: Find two totally unrelated things that share a shape and put their photos side by side.
steps: Pick a shape: circle, triangle, arch or spiral.
Each photograph it somewhere unexpected.
Put the two photos side by side.
Do three shapes and choose your favorite pair.
missions.finish: You have three photo pairs and a favorite.
missions.apart: Shoot in your own places and pair one of yours with one of theirs.

missions.title: Courtroom drama for a teddy
missions.supplies: A phone and a willing defendant (plush toy, houseplant or mug)
missions.description: Put a stuffed animal on trial for eating the last cookie, complete with evidence and a dramatic verdict.
steps: Pick a defendant and invent the crime.
Come up with one piece of 'evidence' each.
One plays the prosecutor, the other the defense; each gets a two-minute speech.
Film the verdict being read.
missions.finish: The verdict is in and on camera.
missions.apart: Hold court over video, each holding your own defendant.

missions.title: Homemade crackers, thin vs. thick
missions.supplies: Flour, oil, water, salt, a baking tray and an oven
missions.description: Bake crackers from flour, oil and water and settle once and for all whether thin or thick wins.
steps: Mix 1 cup flour, a pinch of salt, 2 tablespoons oil and about 1/3 cup water into a dough.
Roll half paper-thin and half a little thicker; sprinkle on seeds or herbs.
Cut into squares and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10 to 15 minutes until golden.
Let them cool, taste both and crown a winner.
missions.finish: The crackers are cool and a winner has been named.
missions.apart: Bake the same recipe on a video call and compare the crunch out loud.

missions.title: Pebble people
missions.supplies: A few pebbles, markers or paint
missions.description: Gather a few smooth stones and turn them into a tiny cast of characters with names and secrets.
steps: Find four to six pebbles on a walk where picking them up is allowed.
Look at each shape and decide who it is.
Draw on faces, outfits or hats.
Introduce each character with a name and one secret.
missions.finish: Your cast is complete and everyone has a name.
missions.apart: Each make two characters and introduce them to each other on video.

missions.title: Five-thing nest
missions.description: Build the coziest corner you can using exactly five things, then spend twenty minutes in it.
steps: Each list your top five cozy essentials.
Negotiate down to one final list of five.
Build the nest.
Spend twenty minutes in it doing nothing important.
missions.finish: You've spent twenty unhurried minutes in your five-thing nest.
missions.apart: Each build your own, then give each other a video tour and hang out in them together.

missions.title: Lunch on a brand-new bench
missions.description: Take an ordinary packed lunch to a bench, step or patch of grass you've walked past but never sat on.
steps: Pack a simple lunch.
Pick a spot you've passed a hundred times but never stopped at.
Eat slowly and people-watch.
Rate the spot out of ten for view, comfort and vibes.
missions.finish: Lunch is eaten and the new spot has a score.
missions.apart: Each find a new spot near you and eat lunch together on a video call.

missions.title: Draw what the song looks like
missions.supplies: Paper, pens or crayons, a speaker
missions.description: Listen to three very different songs and draw whatever each one looks like to you.
steps: Pick three songs that sound nothing alike.
While each one plays, draw without overthinking it.
Shuffle the drawings.
Try to match each other's drawings to the songs.
missions.finish: All three songs are drawn and the matching game is done.
missions.apart: Play the same songs at the same time and hold your drawings up to the camera.

missions.title: Tabletop flick-ball goals
missions.supplies: A cardboard box, scissors, a paper ball or bottle cap
missions.description: Cut three goals into a cardboard box and flick a paper ball through them for points.
steps: Cut three arches into the side of a box: big (1 point), medium (3) and tiny (10).
Stand it at one end of a table.
Take turns flicking a paper ball or bottle cap from the other end.
First to 30 points wins.
missions.finish: Someone has reached 30 points.
missions.apart: Each build a goal box and play over video, keeping honest score.

missions.title: Ride the best-named stations
missions.description: Open a transit map from anywhere in the world and plan a trip that only stops at stations with great names.
steps: Pick any city with a train or subway map.
Each choose three stations purely because of their names.
Plan a route that links all six.
Invent one thing you'd do at each stop.
missions.finish: Your six-stop fantasy route is planned.
missions.apart: Share screens and plan the route together on a call.

missions.title: Ice cream flavor draft
missions.supplies: A menu or freezer aisle with a few flavors
missions.description: Draft flavors like a sports team, then get one small scoop of your top pick and defend your choices.
steps: Look at an ice cream menu or freezer section together.
Take turns drafting one flavor at a time until you each have three.
Get one small scoop or treat of your first pick.
Swap bites and argue for your team.
missions.finish: You've both tasted the top draft picks.
missions.apart: Draft from your own local options over a call, then eat your picks together on video.

missions.title: Questions only
missions.description: Hold a whole conversation using nothing but questions. The first one to answer with a statement loses.
steps: Pick an everyday topic, like dinner plans.
Take turns replying only with a question: 'Why would you want pasta?' 'Don't you?'
No pauses longer than three seconds and no repeating a question.
Play best of three rounds.
missions.finish: Three rounds played and the question champion crowned.
missions.apart: Play over a call or in fast-fire texts.

missions.title: Quietest corner contest
missions.description: Each guess where the quietest spot near you is, then go and listen to find out who's right.
steps: Each name the place you think is the quietest within walking distance.
Visit both, plus one random spot.
At each one, sit silently for two minutes and count the sounds you hear.
The fewest sounds wins.
missions.finish: All three spots are tested and the quietest is crowned.
missions.apart: Each hunt for your own quiet spot and send a 30-second recording of it.

missions.title: Travel poster for nowhere
missions.description: Design a vintage-style travel poster for a vacation spot that doesn't exist.
steps: Invent a destination and give it a name.
Decide what it's famous for: singing rocks, upside-down rain, very polite ducks.
Draw the poster with a big headline and a slogan.
Hang it up somewhere you'll see it.
missions.finish: The poster is finished and on display.
missions.apart: Each design one and send it over, then plan a pretend trip to both.

missions.title: Clue golf
missions.supplies: A book or random word generator
missions.description: Get your partner to guess a secret word using as few one-word clues as possible. Lowest score wins.
steps: Open a book to a random page and pick a noun, keeping it hidden.
Give one-word clues until your partner guesses it.
The number of clues is your score for that hole.
Alternate for nine holes; the lowest total wins.
missions.finish: Nine holes played and a champion declared.
missions.apart: Play over a call, each picking words from your own books.

missions.title: Childhood snack, all grown up
missions.supplies: Your childhood snack, plus one or two extras
missions.description: Take a snack you loved as a kid and give it one clever upgrade.
steps: Each name a favorite snack from when you were little.
Think of one upgrade: a pinch of salt, a drizzle of honey, toasting it.
Make both versions.
Taste the original and the remix side by side.
missions.finish: You've each tried both versions of both snacks.
missions.apart: Make your own remixes on video and tell the story behind your snack.

missions.title: Coin detectives
missions.supplies: A few coins (or a banknote or stamp) and a phone
missions.description: Look closely at the coins in your pocket and dig up the story behind one of the pictures on them.
steps: Lay out a few coins and look at both sides closely.
Each pick one picture or symbol you can't explain.
Look up what it is and why it's there.
Tell each other the story in under a minute.
missions.finish: You've each shared one coin story.
missions.apart: Compare coins from where you each are; they may be from different countries.

missions.title: Free fun list for a friend
missions.description: Write up five free things you love doing nearby and send them to a friend who could use a good weekend.
steps: Brainstorm free things you love near you: a trail, a library event, a great bench.
Pick the best five and add one line on why each is great.
Think of a friend who'd enjoy it.
Send it with a little note.
missions.finish: Your list has been sent.
missions.apart: Each write a list for your own area and share it with a friend near you.

missions.title: Ten-second sound souvenir
missions.description: Record ten seconds of today's soundtrack, like the kettle, the rain or the two of you laughing.
steps: Notice a sound that feels like 'today.'
Record just ten seconds of it.
Name the clip with the date and a short title.
Save it in a shared folder for later.
missions.finish: Today's sound is saved and labeled.
missions.apart: Each record a sound from your day and swap them before bed.

missions.title: Three-clue mystery by text
missions.description: Write a tiny whodunit set in your own home and send your partner one clue a day until they crack it.
steps: Invent a tiny mystery, like 'Who moved the remote?', with three suspects (objects and pets count).
Send one clue a day as a photo or a text.
Your partner sends their guess after clue three.
Reveal the culprit in a dramatic voice note.
missions.finish: The case is solved and the culprit revealed.
missions.apart: Made for distance: it works even if your schedules never line up.

missions.title: Town in the mirror
missions.description: Collect three reflections that make your street look like somewhere else: puddles, shop windows, car doors.
steps: Head out and look for shiny surfaces.
Photograph three reflections that make the place look strange or new.
Flip one upside down and see if it still works.
Pick your best one.
missions.finish: You have three reflections and a favorite.
missions.apart: Each collect three in your own town and swap your favorites.

missions.title: Four seasons on one table
missions.supplies: A small object like a mug or plant, plus household odds and ends
missions.description: Style one small scene four times as spring, summer, fall and winter using things around the house.
steps: Pick a star object and a spot on a table.
Style it for spring and take a photo.
Restyle it for summer, fall and winter with props like cotton balls, a scarf or leaves.
Put the four photos in a grid.
missions.finish: Your four-season grid is done.
missions.apart: Each do two seasons with similar objects and combine them into one grid.

missions.title: Three-sound spooky story
missions.supplies: A flashlight or phone light, three noisy household things
missions.description: Tell a cozy-spooky story in the dark using only three sound effects you make with household things.
steps: Each pick a household sound: a creaky door, a crinkly bag, a spoon on a glass.
Turn the lights down.
Take turns telling the story, using each sound at least once.
End on the scariest sound.
missions.finish: The story is told and all three sounds were used.
missions.apart: Tell it over a call with your lights off and do the sounds on your end.

missions.title: Pizza constellations
missions.supplies: A flatbread or tortilla, sauce, cheese and small toppings
missions.description: Make a flatbread pizza, arrange the toppings into your own constellation, and give it a name.
steps: Spread sauce and cheese on a flatbread.
Arrange small toppings as stars in a new constellation.
Name it and invent its legend.
Bake until bubbly, take a photo, then eat the sky.
missions.finish: Your constellation is named, photographed and eaten.
missions.apart: Each make your own on video and tell each other the legends.

missions.title: After-the-rain walk
missions.supplies: Shoes you don't mind getting wet
missions.description: Next time it rains, head out right after and find five things that only look this way when they're wet.
steps: Wait for a shower to finish.
Walk a route you know well.
Find five things that changed: shiny leaves, smells, worms, puddle reflections.
Each pick your favorite rainy detail.
missions.finish: You've found five rain details and each picked a favorite.
missions.apart: Whenever it rains where one of you is, send the other a rain report with photos.

missions.title: Bedtime radio play
missions.description: Perform a three-scene bedtime story with silly voices and sound effects, lights low.
steps: Pick a hero, a place and a small problem.
Each voice different characters.
Perform three short scenes: setup, trouble, happy ending.
Add at least one sound effect per scene.
missions.finish: All three scenes have been performed.
missions.apart: Perform it on a call with lights off, as if you're on old-time radio.

missions.title: Atlas trip at the library
missions.description: Find an atlas at the library, close your eyes, point at a page, and plan a dream trip to wherever you land.
steps: Go to your local library and find a big atlas.
Take turns closing your eyes and pointing at a random page.
Look up one fun fact about each place you land.
Plan a pretend itinerary linking both spots.
missions.finish: You've planned a trip between two random places.
missions.apart: Use an online map instead: each spin the globe, land somewhere and share what you find.

missions.title: Body-percussion stack
missions.description: Build a rhythm together one sound at a time: clap, stomp, snap, thigh-slap.
steps: One of you starts a simple beat with claps.
The other adds a stomp on top.
Keep adding sounds until it falls apart.
Try to beat your record of layers.
missions.finish: You've built a beat with at least four layers.
missions.apart: Take turns adding layers by recording short clips and sending them back and forth.

missions.title: Tiny furniture, no glue
missions.supplies: A cereal box, scissors, a pencil
missions.description: Make a tiny table and chair from cereal-box cardboard, using only slots that slide together.
steps: Cut flat pieces for a chair and a table.
Cut matching slots so pieces slide into each other.
Assemble them without glue or tape.
Test strength with a coin or small toy.
missions.finish: Your tiny set is standing and holds a coin.
missions.apart: Build at the same time on a video call and compare furniture.

missions.title: Settle a burning question
missions.description: Pick something you've both wondered about, like 'Do penguins have knees?', and find three good sources.
steps: Each name one question you've always wondered about.
Choose the more intriguing one.
Look for three trustworthy sources, like museums or universities.
Agree on the answer and share the coolest detail.
missions.finish: You've settled the question with three sources.
missions.apart: Research on your own, then compare findings on a call.

missions.title: Walk the trail you always skip
missions.description: Finally try that short marked walking path you've seen signs for a hundred times but never taken.
steps: Think of a short, well-marked path near you that neither of you has walked.
Check it's open and easy, and tell someone where you're going if it's quiet.
Walk it at a slow pace and stop whenever something looks interesting.
Decide whether it earns a spot on your regular-walks list.
missions.finish: You've walked the whole path and given it a verdict.
missions.apart: Each try an overlooked path near you and send three photos from the best bits.

missions.title: One-line monsters
missions.description: Draw a monster without lifting your pen once, then name it and give it a terrible hobby.
steps: Put your pen on the paper.
Draw a whole monster in one continuous line, no lifting.
Give it a name and one terrible hobby.
Swap monsters and introduce each other's.
missions.finish: Both monsters have names and hobbies.
missions.apart: Draw on a call and hold your monsters up to the camera at the same time.

missions.title: Then-and-now street photo
missions.description: Find an old photo of your street or town online and stand exactly where the photographer once stood.
steps: Search your town's name plus 'old photo' or check a local history archive.
Pick a photo of somewhere you can walk to.
Go there and line up the same view.
Take a matching photo and list three things that changed.
missions.finish: You have a then-and-now pair and three spotted changes.
missions.apart: Each do it for your own town and swap then-and-now pairs.

missions.title: Fold-over creatures
missions.description: Draw a creature in three secret sections, folding the paper each time, then unfold the monster you made together.
steps: Fold a sheet into three strips.
One draws a head on the top strip, folds it over and leaves two little lines showing where the neck goes.
The other draws the body; fold again, then the first one draws the legs.
Unfold and give your creature a name.
missions.finish: Your creature is unfolded and named.
missions.apart: Mail the folded paper back and forth, or each draw a section and stack the photos.

missions.title: Cup pyramid speed stack
missions.supplies: Six or ten cups each, a timer
missions.description: Stack paper or plastic cups into a pyramid and back down again as fast as you can, against the clock.
steps: Each take the same number of cups.
On 'go,' build a pyramid (3-2-1 or 4-3-2-1), then stack it back into one tower.
Time each run; a toppled pyramid means you rebuild it.
Best of five, then try it with your other hand.
missions.finish: Five rounds raced and a speed-stacking champion named.
missions.apart: Race on a video call with your own cups and a shared countdown.

missions.title: Two-ingredient bites
missions.supplies: Whatever's in your fridge and pantry
missions.description: Make tiny snacks where every bite uses exactly two ingredients, then pick the surprise winner.
steps: Each pick four ingredients from your kitchen.
Pair them up into as many two-ingredient bites as you can.
Arrange them on a plate like party food.
Taste everything and vote on the best pair.
missions.finish: Every bite has been tried and one pair won.
missions.apart: Each make three bites at home and describe them on a call.

missions.title: Measure a tree with a pencil
missions.supplies: A pencil and a long tape measure, or count your steps
