missions.description: Work out how tall a tree is using nothing but a pencil, your partner and a little bit of clever geometry.
steps: Stand back from a tree and hold a pencil at arm's length so it lines up from the trunk's base to the top.
Turn the pencil sideways, keeping its base at the trunk, and have your partner walk to where the tip now points.
Measure or pace the distance from your partner to the trunk; that's roughly the tree's height.
Guess first, then compare your guess with the answer.
missions.finish: You've measured one tree and seen whose guess was closer.
missions.apart: Each measure a tree near you with help from a friend, or guess heights from photos and compare.

missions.title: Chalk good news
missions.description: Leave bright, kind chalk messages on a path where neighbors will see them, wherever chalk is welcome.
steps: Pick a spot where chalk is welcome, like your own front path or a park that allows it.
Write three short messages: 'You're doing great,' a sun with a face, a terrible joke.
Add some colorful borders.
Take a photo before the rain does its thing.
missions.finish: Three kind messages are on the ground and photographed.
missions.apart: Each chalk your own path and send photos of your messages.

missions.title: Voice memo to us in a year
missions.description: Record a short message about what life is like right now and set it to open in a year.
steps: Each think of three things that sum up this moment in your lives.
Record a two-minute voice memo together.
Mention one thing you hope is still true next year.
Save it and put a reminder in your calendar a year from now.
missions.finish: The memo is saved and the reminder is set.
missions.apart: Record over a call, or each record half and save them together.

missions.title: Guess the mystery sounds
missions.description: Send each other three mystery sounds from around your home and see who can guess the most.
steps: Each record three short sounds at home: a zipper, a drawer, the fridge door.
Send them one at a time with no hints.
Your partner gets two guesses per sound.
Reveal the answers with photos.
missions.finish: All six sounds have been guessed and revealed.
missions.apart: Made for distance: send whenever you're free and guess whenever you see them.

missions.title: Faces in everyday things
missions.description: Spot faces hiding in outlets, windows, cars and doorknobs, and give the best one a name.
steps: Walk somewhere and look for accidental faces.
Snap every one you spot.
Give each a name and a mood.
Pick the face of the day.
missions.finish: You've found at least five faces and crowned one.
missions.apart: Each hunt in your own neighborhood and swap photos.

missions.title: Film-noir detective shot
missions.supplies: A lamp, a phone, a hat or coat
missions.description: Stage one dramatic detective photo using a lamp, deep shadows and a very suspicious mug.
steps: Turn off the main lights and use one lamp from the side.
Set up a desk scene with a 'clue.'
Pose like a weary detective.
Shoot in black and white and add a caption.
missions.finish: Your detective photo has a caption.
missions.apart: Each shoot your own scene and combine them into a two-panel story.

missions.title: Magic match cut
missions.supplies: A phone propped up steady, two small objects
missions.description: Film a tiny 'magic trick' where one object turns into another with a perfectly matched cut.
steps: Prop the phone so it doesn't move.
Film someone holding an apple, then stop.
Swap the apple for an orange in the same spot and film again.
Join the clips and try a chain of three transformations.
missions.finish: You've got a clip with three smooth transformations.
missions.apart: Make the object 'teleport' from your hand on camera to your partner's in the next clip.

missions.title: Smoothie in a color
missions.supplies: Fruit, yogurt or milk, and a blender or fork
missions.description: Pull a color out of a hat and make a drink that matches it.
steps: Write colors on slips: pink, green, orange, purple, yellow.
Each draw one without peeking.
Make a drink in that color from what you have.
Taste and judge on color and flavor.
missions.finish: Both drinks are made and judged.
missions.apart: Draw colors over chat and make your drinks on video.

missions.title: Kitchen seed museum
missions.supplies: Seeds from your kitchen, paper and pencil
missions.description: Line up seeds from your kitchen, like apple pips, beans and spices, and sketch them like a museum display.
steps: Gather five kinds of seeds you already have.
Lay them out on white paper.
Sketch each one big and label it.
Guess which would be easiest to grow.
missions.finish: Your seed display has five labeled sketches.
missions.apart: Each make a display and compare photos.

missions.title: Camp out in the living room
missions.description: Turn the living room into a campsite with blankets, a flashlight 'campfire', snacks and stories.
steps: Build a tent from blankets and chairs.
Set up a flashlight campfire.
Bring snacks and tell stories.
Sleep there or stay until you get sleepy.
missions.finish: You've spent an evening in your indoor camp.
missions.apart: Each build a tent and video call from inside it.

missions.title: Fantasy town from one building
missions.description: Pick one interesting building and design a tiny fantasy town where every house borrows something from it.
steps: Find a building you like: a library, an old church, a clock tower.
Spot three features: arches, towers, windows.
Sketch a town of five houses using those details.
Name the town and its mayor.
missions.finish: Your town is sketched and named.
missions.apart: Each pick a building near you and merge them into one town.

missions.title: Learn a chorus in a new language
missions.supplies: A phone and the song's lyrics
missions.description: Pick a song in a language neither of you speaks and learn to sing the chorus together.
steps: Choose a catchy song in a language you don't know.
Find the chorus lyrics online.
Practice line by line.
Perform the chorus together.
missions.finish: You can both sing the chorus all the way through.
missions.apart: Practice separately, then perform on video.

missions.title: Paper boat cargo race
missions.supplies: Paper, coins, a sink or tub of water
missions.description: Fold paper boats and see whose can carry the most coins before sinking.
steps: Each fold a paper boat.
Float them in a sink or tub.
Add coins one at a time.
Count how many each holds before it sinks.
missions.finish: Both boats have sunk and a winner is declared.
missions.apart: Race on a video call with your own boats.

missions.title: Doodle on each other's photos
missions.description: Send a photo back and forth three times, each adding something silly with your phone's markup tool.
steps: One sends an ordinary photo.
The other adds a drawing, sticker or caption and sends it back.
Repeat until it's been edited three times each.
Name the final masterpiece.
missions.finish: Your photo has six edits and a title.
missions.apart: Made for distance: send edits whenever you have a spare minute.

missions.title: Homemade photo booth strip
missions.description: Take four photos in a row that tell a tiny story, just like an old photo booth.
steps: Pick a four-beat story: a surprise, mock outrage, a big hug, helpless laughing.
Prop the phone and set a timer.
Take four shots in a row.
Put them in a vertical strip.
missions.finish: Your photo strip is finished.
missions.apart: Take screenshots during a video call for each panel.

missions.title: Thirty-second pitch for a useless invention
missions.description: Invent something completely pointless and sell it to your partner in thirty seconds flat.
steps: Each invent a useless gadget.
Take turns pitching it in thirty seconds.
The listener decides whether to 'invest'.
Swap and try again with a new invention.
missions.finish: Two inventions have been pitched and judged.
missions.apart: Pitch on a video call with your best serious face.

missions.title: Smallest park expedition
missions.description: Find the tiniest green space near you and explore it like it's a national park.
steps: Look up the smallest park or green patch near you.
Go and explore it slowly.
Find three things you'd show a tour group.
Invent an official name and motto.
missions.finish: You've explored it and given it a name and motto.
missions.apart: Each explore one near you and give each other a video tour.

missions.title: Shoebox pinhole viewer
missions.supplies: A shoebox, foil, white paper, tape, a pin
missions.description: Turn a cardboard box into a pinhole viewer and watch your room appear upside down inside it.
steps: Cut a small square in one end of the box and cover it with foil.
Poke one tiny pinhole in the foil.
Tape white paper inside the opposite end and cut a viewing hole near it.
Point it at a bright window, never at the sun, and look for the upside-down image.
missions.finish: You've both seen the upside-down picture inside the box.
missions.apart: Build on a call and hold your phone camera to the viewing hole to share what you see.

missions.title: Charades of impossible jobs
missions.description: Act out jobs that shouldn't exist, like cloud shepherd or professional sock matcher, and guess each other's.
steps: Each write five ridiculous job titles.
Swap slips.
Take turns acting them out with no words.
Score a point for each correct guess.
missions.finish: All ten jobs have been acted out.
missions.apart: Play on video with slips you text to each other privately.

missions.title: Three-minute cooking show
missions.supplies: A phone and a simple snack
missions.description: Film a cooking show for the simplest snack you know, with full celebrity-chef drama.
steps: Choose a snack: toast, fruit cup, cheese and crackers.
One is the chef, the other the camera person.
Film a three-minute show with intro, steps and a taste test.
Swap roles for a second episode.
missions.finish: Two episodes are filmed and the snacks are eaten.
missions.apart: Film your episode at home and swap videos.

missions.title: Make a teddy heroic
missions.description: Use three classic camera angles to make the same stuffed toy look heroic, tiny and sneaky.
steps: Shoot from below to make it look heroic.
Shoot from above to make it look small.
Shoot at a tilted angle to make it look sneaky.
Compare and discuss which angle works best.
missions.finish: You have three photos and a favorite angle.
missions.apart: Each shoot your own toy and share the photo set.

missions.title: Ten things to give away
missions.description: Find ten things in good shape you never use, and get them to someone who will.
steps: Each pick a closet, drawer or shelf to look through.
Pull out ten things in good condition that haven't been used in a year.
Pack them up, with a note on anything that needs explaining, like a missing lid.
Drop them at a donation spot or offer them to a friend or a local swap group.
missions.finish: All ten things have left the house for a new home.
missions.apart: Each fill your own bag on a video call, holding up the funniest find before it goes.

missions.title: Memory map of one room
missions.description: Draw a floor plan of a room you both know, then mark it with moments instead of furniture.
steps: Pick a room that's seen a lot of your life together, or a favorite room from childhood.
Draw a simple outline from above: walls, door, windows.
Mark spots with tiny notes instead of furniture: 'big laugh here,' 'the soup incident.'
Date it and tuck it somewhere you'll find it again.
missions.finish: Your map has at least five moments marked on it.
missions.apart: Each map a room from your own home or past and talk each other through it on a call.

missions.title: Restyle my shelf by remote
missions.supplies: A shelf, desk or windowsill, and a video call
missions.description: Your partner directs a makeover of one of your shelves over video, and you must follow every instruction.
steps: Prop your phone so your partner can see the whole shelf.
They give directions only: 'move the plant left,' 'lose the stack of mail.'
Follow them exactly, even if you have doubts.
Give them a final reveal, then swap and restyle theirs.
missions.finish: Both shelves have had a remote makeover and a big reveal.
missions.apart: Made for distance: leave the new layout up for a week and report back.

missions.title: Cat census
missions.description: Walk the neighborhood counting every cat you spot in windows, on walls and under cars, and give each one a name.
steps: Pick a route with plenty of houses and windows.
Spot every cat you can, from a polite distance.
Give each one a name and a job title: 'Gerald, Head of Security.'
Total up at the end; no cats spotted means you name the pigeons instead.
missions.finish: The census is complete and every cat has a name.
missions.apart: Run a cat census on your own walks and compare your totals and best names.

missions.title: Five-line photo hunt
missions.description: Photograph a straight line, a curve, a crossing, a zigzag and a spiral before you get home.
steps: Head out with your list of five lines.
Find each one somewhere unexpected: a shadow, a staircase, a snail shell.
Crop each photo so the line really stands out.
Put all five in a collage and pick the cleverest find.
missions.finish: All five lines are captured and in one collage.
missions.apart: Each hunt near you and put your two collages side by side.

missions.title: Opening credits for our show
missions.description: Make the opening credits for a TV show about your perfectly ordinary life together.
steps: Agree on a show title and a theme song.
Film five two-second clips of everyday moments: keys, kettle, a wave, a dramatic glance.
Add your names as the stars, plus a 'special guest' like a houseplant.
Stitch it together with the music and watch the premiere.
missions.finish: Your credits are finished and premiered.
missions.apart: Each film clips of your own day, then combine them so the show cuts between your two places.

missions.title: Blind taste-test scorecard
missions.supplies: Three versions of one food, like three kinds of chips, apples or chocolate
missions.description: Taste three versions of one favorite food blind, judged on a scorecard you invent together.
steps: Pick a food and get three versions of it.
Make a scorecard with your own categories: crunch, comfort, 'would fight for the last one.'
Take turns serving the other bites blind.
Reveal the labels and see if your favorite is the one you expected.
missions.finish: The scores are in and the winner is revealed.
missions.apart: Each test versions you can find locally and compare scorecards on a call.

missions.title: Sun patch vs. shade patch
missions.description: Compare a sunny spot and a shady spot right next to each other: what grows, what crawls, how it feels.
steps: Find a sunny patch and a shady patch close together.
Spend five minutes in each noticing plants, bugs, moss and how warm the ground is.
Write down three differences.
Each make a guess about why, then look one up.
missions.finish: You've listed three differences and checked one guess.
missions.apart: Compare patches in your two places on a call and send photos.

missions.title: Puzzle, blankets, no phones
missions.supplies: A puzzle or crossword, blankets, snacks
missions.description: Start a jigsaw or crossword under blankets with snacks and one rule: phones live in another room.
steps: Pick a puzzle or print a crossword.
Set up blankets, snacks and soft music.
Put your phones in another room.
Work on it for an hour, with zero pressure to finish.
missions.finish: You've spent a full hour on the puzzle.
missions.apart: Do the same online puzzle while on a call, with every other tab closed.

missions.title: Postcard of your own town
missions.supplies: A blank card or stiff paper, pens, a stamp
missions.description: Find the prettiest view within a short walk, draw it on a card, and actually mail it to someone.
steps: Walk around looking for the best view near home.
Sketch it on the card, or glue on a printed photo.
Write a short 'wish you were here' note on the back.
Mail it to a friend or relative who'd love some real mail.
missions.finish: Your postcard is in the mailbox.
missions.apart: Mail your postcards to each other instead.

missions.title: Kitchen orchestra conductor
missions.description: Make an orchestra of pots and wooden spoons, and let the conductor run it with made-up hand signals.
steps: Set up a drum kit of kitchen things.
The conductor invents signals for loud, soft, fast, slow and stop.
Play a piece following the signals, no matter how chaotic.
Swap roles and see who's the stricter conductor.
missions.finish: You've each conducted one piece.
missions.apart: Each set up a kitchen kit and take turns conducting over video.

missions.title: Patent for a ridiculous invention
missions.description: Draw an absurd invention as a deadly serious patent application, complete with numbered parts.
steps: Each invent a machine that solves a tiny problem, like finding the end of the tape roll.
Draw it with numbered, labeled parts.
Write a very official description: 'Figure 3: the sock-detection whisker.'
Sign, date and approve each other's patent.
missions.finish: Both patents are drawn, signed and approved.
missions.apart: Present your patents to each other on video like a review board.

missions.title: Street View teleport game
missions.description: Drop into a random spot on Street View and see who can guess the country first.
steps: Open a map app with Street View.
One of you drops the little figure somewhere random without saying where.
The other explores and guesses the country from signs, cars and plants.
Swap and play five rounds each.
missions.finish: Ten rounds played and a world champion named.
missions.apart: Share your screen on a call and take turns being the guide.

missions.title: Learn one dance step
missions.supplies: A phone or laptop and a bit of floor
missions.description: Pick a beginner dance step from a free online video and practice until you can do it to a song.
steps: Find a beginner tutorial for one fun step: a grapevine, a basic salsa, a cha-cha slide.
Watch it once all the way through.
Practice slowly, then at real speed, at whatever range of motion feels good.
Put on a song and do it together.
missions.finish: You've both done the step to a full song.
missions.apart: Learn the same step and do your performance on video.

missions.title: Predict my next three choices
missions.description: Guess your partner's answers to three quick this-or-that questions, then see how well you really know them.
steps: Write three this-or-that questions: cereal or toast, beach or forest, call or text.
Secretly jot down what you think your partner will pick.
Ask them out loud and reveal your predictions.
Swap with three new questions.
missions.finish: Both of you have predicted and been tested.
missions.apart: Send your predictions as a hidden note first, then ask on a call.

missions.title: One spot, five senses
missions.description: Stand in one outdoor spot and describe it using all five senses, phones in pockets.
steps: Pick a spot you pass all the time.
Each write one thing you notice for every sense; for taste, use the air or a snack you brought.
Read your lists out loud.
Pick the most surprising thing either of you noticed.
missions.finish: You've each written five sense notes.
missions.apart: Each do it wherever you are and swap lists, then guess what the other's spot looks like.

missions.title: Wrapping paper from three shapes
missions.supplies: Large paper or a paper bag, colored pens
missions.description: Design a repeating pattern from three simple shapes and turn it into homemade wrapping paper.
steps: Each pick one or two simple shapes, like a dot, a leaf and a zigzag.
Agree on an arrangement and how it repeats.
Cover a big sheet with the pattern, splitting it down the middle.
Use it to wrap something, even if it's just a snack for each other.
missions.finish: Your paper is covered and wrapped around a gift.
missions.apart: Each design a sheet and mail each other something small wrapped in it.

missions.title: Paper airplane golf
missions.description: Set targets around the house and see who can hit them all in the fewest throws.
steps: Pick five targets around a room or hallway: a chair, a pillow, a laundry basket.
Each fold your best paper airplane.
Play each 'hole' from the same starting spot, counting throws until you hit it.
Lowest total after five holes wins.
missions.finish: All five holes played and scores totaled.
missions.apart: Set up courses at home, describe your holes, and play over video.

missions.title: Trail mix draft day
missions.supplies: Small bowls of nuts or seeds, dried fruit, cereal, crackers or chocolate chips
missions.description: Set out bowls of nuts, seeds, dried fruit and snacks, build your own trail mixes, and name them like candy bars.
steps: Put out five or six small bowls of mix-ins from your cupboards.
Take turns choosing one scoop at a time for your own mix.
Name your mix and write a tiny label for it.
Taste each other's and pack the leftovers for your next walk.
missions.finish: Two named mixes are made and tasted.
missions.apart: Make mixes from your own cupboards on video and describe yours like a snack commercial.

missions.title: Fact or fib
missions.description: Each find one weird true fact and invent one convincing fake, then guess which is which.
steps: Each find one strange but true fact.
Invent one fake fact that sounds just as plausible.
Take turns sharing both, in either order.
Guess the real one, then show your source.
missions.finish: Both of you have guessed and sources have been shown.
missions.apart: Play over text or a call; it's great for a few spare minutes.

missions.title: Thank-you comic
missions.description: Draw a four-panel comic about a time someone helped you, and send it to them.
steps: Each think of a time a friend, teacher or neighbor helped you out.
Draw the moment in four simple panels; stick figures are perfect.
Add a short thank-you in the last panel.
Send a photo of it, or mail the real thing.
missions.finish: Both comics have been sent.
missions.apart: Draw on a video call and show each other before sending.

missions.title: Trading cards for this season of life
missions.description: Make a set of collectible cards for the songs, snacks and habits that define your life right now.
steps: Pick five things that sum up right now: a song, a snack, a place, a phrase, a habit.
Make a card for each with a drawing and silly stats, like 'Comfort: 9.'
Swap cards and read each other's.
Keep the set in an envelope labeled with the date.
missions.finish: Your card set is complete and labeled.
missions.apart: Each make a set and mail them to each other.

missions.title: Cook from my voice notes
missions.description: Cook a dish your partner knows by heart, using only their voice notes instead of a written recipe.
steps: Your partner picks a simple dish they make often and sends step-by-step voice notes.
Follow them without looking anything up.
Send a photo of the finished dish and an honest review.
Swap roles another day.
missions.finish: The dish is cooked, photographed and reviewed.
missions.apart: Made for distance: if your schedules line up, cook on a call so they can coach live.

missions.title: Fake tour guides
missions.description: Take turns giving dramatic, completely made-up guided tours of the most ordinary buildings on your street.
steps: Walk a short stretch of any street.
Take turns stopping at a building and giving its 'history': who lived there, what scandal happened.
The listener can ask one tourist question, which must be answered with total confidence.
Give at least three tours each.
missions.finish: Six fake tours given and one crowned most believable.
missions.apart: Give each other tours of your own streets on a video call while you walk.

missions.title: Copycat photo challenge
missions.description: One of you sends a photo, the other recreates it using only what's within ten steps of where they're standing.
steps: One of you takes a photo with a clear composition: a mug by a window, a shoe on a step.
The other has five minutes to recreate it with completely different objects.
Put the two photos side by side.
Swap roles and score each copy on cleverness.
missions.finish: You've each made one copycat photo.
missions.apart: Perfect from different places: text the photo and set a five-minute timer.

missions.title: Shadow puppet short film
missions.supplies: A flashlight or phone light, a plain wall, a second phone to film
missions.description: Turn off the lights, shine a flashlight at the wall, and film a tiny story told with hand shadows.
steps: Prop up a light so it shines on a blank wall.
Practice a few hand shadows: a bird, a dog, a snapping crocodile.
Plan a three-part story where two shadow characters meet.
Film it with your best narration and sound effects.
missions.finish: Your shadow film is recorded and watched.
missions.apart: Each make one character on your own wall and act out the story together on video.

missions.title: Tallest sandwich you can still eat
missions.description: Build the tallest open sandwich you can that still survives being eaten without collapsing.
steps: Lay out bread and every sandwich-friendly thing you have.
Take turns adding one layer at a time.
Stop when one of you says 'any more and it falls.'
Measure it, photograph it, then try to eat it with dignity.
missions.finish: Your tower is measured, photographed and eaten.
missions.apart: Build at the same time on video and compare heights with a ruler.

missions.title: Leaf rubbing gallery
missions.supplies: Fallen leaves, plain paper, crayons or a soft pencil
missions.description: Collect fallen leaves, rub over them with crayon, and make a little gallery of their hidden veins.
steps: Gather five different fallen leaves on a walk.
Put a leaf under a sheet of paper, vein side up.
Rub over it gently with the side of a crayon until the pattern appears.
Label each one with where you found it and give the gallery a name.
missions.finish: You have a five-leaf gallery with labels.
missions.apart: Each make a gallery from your own neighborhood and swap photos to compare trees.

missions.title: Hide-and-seek drawing
missions.description: Draw a cozy scene with five tiny objects hidden in it, then let your partner hunt for them.
steps: Each draw a cozy room or landscape.
Secretly hide five tiny things in it: a key, a snail, a heart, a sock, a moon.
Swap drawings and hunt for all five.
The finder gets a point for each object found in under three minutes.
missions.finish: Both drawings have been searched.
missions.apart: Send photos of your drawings and hunt for the objects while on a call.

missions.title: Read every plaque on one street
missions.description: Walk one street and read every historical plaque and info sign until you find the most surprising fact.
steps: Pick a street, park or square with a few plaques or signs.
Read every single one, even the dull-looking ones.
Each choose the most surprising fact you found.
Tell it to someone else later.
missions.finish: You've read every sign and each picked a favorite fact.
missions.apart: Each do it on your own street and share your favorite fact with a photo of the sign.

missions.title: Movie montage for a chore
missions.description: Pick three songs that turn a boring chore into a dramatic movie montage, then do the chore to them.
steps: Pick a chore you've been avoiding: dishes, laundry, sorting a drawer.
Each choose one song for the montage; agree on a third together.
Hit play and do the chore like you're in the big training scene.
Freeze in a victory pose when the last song ends.
missions.finish: The chore is done and the victory pose was struck.
missions.apart: Share the playlist and do your own chores at the same time on a call.

missions.title: Balloon rocket on a string
missions.description: Race balloon rockets along a string across the room and tweak them until one zooms all the way.
steps: Thread a straw onto a long string and tie the string between two chairs.
Blow up a balloon, pinch it shut, and tape it to the straw.
Let go and see how far it travels.
Take turns tweaking balloon size and tape and race again.
missions.finish: A rocket has made it all the way across.
missions.apart: Each build a track at home and measure distances on a video call.

missions.title: Pixel picture puzzle
missions.supplies: A phone or laptop, or a printed puzzle
missions.description: Solve a free nonogram (pixel picture puzzle) together, one calling out clues and one filling squares.
steps: Find a free beginner nonogram online, about 10 by 10 squares.
One reads the number clues, the other fills in squares.
Swap roles halfway through.
Guess what the picture is before it's finished.
missions.finish: The picture is revealed.
missions.apart: Open the same puzzle on a call and solve it as a team.

missions.title: Tourists in your own town
missions.supplies: A phone and a pretend tourist attitude
missions.description: Spend an afternoon as tourists where you live: visit two free sights and take the classic posed photos.
steps: Pick two free landmarks, museums or viewpoints you've never really visited.
Act like visitors: read the signs, ask a local for a tip.
Take the cheesiest tourist photo you can at each.
Find one thing you'd recommend to a real tourist.
missions.finish: Two sights visited and two cheesy photos taken.
missions.apart: Each be a tourist in your own town and send a postcard-style photo from each stop.

missions.title: Silent movie disaster
missions.description: Act out a tiny everyday disaster with no words at all, like an old silent film.
steps: Each think of a small disaster: dropped toast, a stuck jar, a sneeze mid-sip.
Perform it silently with huge facial expressions.
Your partner guesses what happened.
Add dramatic 'piano music' by humming for the encore.
missions.finish: Both disasters have been performed and guessed.
missions.apart: Perform on video; bonus points for black-and-white filter.

missions.title: Street-name story
missions.description: Collect five street names nearby and use every one in one ridiculous story.
steps: Walk or look at a map and note five street names near you.
Take turns adding sentences to a story, using one street name each turn.
Keep going until all five have appeared.
Give the story a title and read it out loud.
missions.finish: Your story uses all five street names.
missions.apart: Each collect names from your own neighborhood and mix them into one story.

missions.title: Corner bookmarks with faces
missions.description: Fold paper corner bookmarks and turn each one into a little creature that hugs your page.
steps: Find a quick tutorial for an origami corner bookmark.
Each fold two.
Turn them into creatures: a monster, a frog, a sleepy cat.
Swap one with each other for your current books.
missions.finish: You've each got a creature bookmark in the other's book.
missions.apart: Fold on a call and mail one of your bookmarks to each other.

missions.title: Draw-write telephone
missions.description: Turn a sentence into a drawing, the drawing into a sentence, and see how wildly it changes.
steps: Write a strange sentence: 'A cat runs a tiny bakery.'
Pass it on; your partner draws it, folds the sentence away, and passes it back.
Write what you think the drawing shows, fold, and pass again.
After six turns, unfold the whole thing and compare.
missions.finish: Six rounds done and the final result revealed.
missions.apart: Text each other photos of drawings and sentences, one turn at a time.

missions.title: Fancy fruit plate challenge
missions.supplies: A few kinds of fruit, two plates, a knife
missions.description: Start with the same fruit and each style a plate that looks like it belongs in a very fancy restaurant.
steps: Split the fruit evenly between you.
Slice, fan, stack or arrange it however you like.
Give your plate a pretentious menu name.
Present them to each other with a waiter's flourish, then eat both.
missions.finish: Both plates have been presented and eaten.
missions.apart: Style plates with your own fruit on video and score each other's presentation.

missions.title: Tap a message in Morse code
missions.description: Learn just enough Morse code to tap a secret three-word message to each other.
steps: Look up a Morse chart.
Each write a three-word message.
Tap it out on the table, slowly, with short and long taps.
Decode each other's message.
missions.finish: Both messages are decoded.
missions.apart: Tap over a call or send a recording of your taps.

missions.title: Pop-up party kit
missions.supplies: A small box, a card, candles or confetti, a treat
missions.description: Pack a little box with everything you need to celebrate a friend's good news at a moment's notice.
steps: Find a small box.
Add a blank card, a candle, confetti or ribbon, and a treat that keeps.
Decorate the box.
Keep it ready, and use it the next time someone you know has good news.
missions.finish: Your kit is packed and ready.
missions.apart: Each make one and show the contents on video.

missions.title: Guess why this song matters
missions.description: Play each other a song that means something to you, and let your partner guess why before you tell the story.
steps: Each pick a song with a memory attached.
Play it without saying anything.
Your partner guesses the story behind it.
Tell the real story.
missions.finish: Both songs and stories have been shared.
missions.apart: Play the songs over a call or send links with a voice note story.

missions.title: Museum audio guide for you
missions.description: Pick an artwork from a free online museum and record a one-minute audio guide for your partner.
steps: Browse a free online museum collection.
Each pick one artwork you find interesting.
Record a one-minute guide: what to look at, why you like it, and one strange detail.
Swap links and recordings, and listen while you look.
missions.finish: You've each listened to the other's guide.
missions.apart: Made for distance: listen whenever you have a quiet minute.

missions.title: Take the long way home
missions.description: Walk home a way you've never tried and find three things you'd have missed on your usual route.
steps: Pick a route home (or back from an errand) that you've never taken.
Walk it a little slower than usual.
Each point out three things that surprised you: a weird mailbox, a great smell, a hidden staircase.
Vote on whether it becomes your new usual route.
missions.finish: You've found six surprises between you and reached a verdict.
missions.apart: Each take a new route where you are and send your three surprises as photos.

missions.title: Near, middle, far
missions.description: Take one photo with something close, something in the middle and something far away, all telling one story.
steps: Look for a scene with layers: a leaf in front, a bench in the middle, a hill or rooftop behind.
Crouch, lean or step sideways until all three line up.
Take a few versions, tapping to focus on a different layer each time.
Pick the best and give it a title like a gallery piece.
missions.finish: You have one layered photo each, with titles.
missions.apart: Each shoot one where you are and guess the title of the other's before it's revealed.

missions.title: Director's commentary on nothing
missions.description: Record a grand director's commentary over a one-minute video of something totally ordinary.
steps: Film one minute of something mundane: making tea, folding a towel, looking for keys.
Play it back and record yourselves talking over it like famous film directors.
Use phrases like 'a bold creative choice' and 'that moment was completely improvised.'
Watch the final cut together.
missions.finish: Your commentary track is recorded and watched.
missions.apart: Each film a clip and record the commentary for the other's video.

missions.title: Great cookie dunk-off
missions.supplies: Three or four kinds of cookies, a mug of tea, milk or hot chocolate
missions.description: Dunk different cookies into a warm drink and find out which one survives longest before crumbling.
steps: Line up the contenders and make predictions.
Dunk each cookie for three seconds, then five, then eight.
Note when each one flops, sags or sinks.
Crown a champion and eat the survivors.
missions.finish: A champion cookie has been crowned.
missions.apart: Run the dunk-off with your own cookies on video and compare winners.

missions.title: Map every sound
missions.description: Sit outside for five minutes and draw a map of every sound you hear, near and far.
steps: Sit somewhere outside, or by an open window.
Draw yourself as a dot in the middle of the page.
Mark each sound where it seems to come from: a bird up and left, traffic far right.
Compare maps and see who heard what the other missed.
missions.finish: Both sound maps are drawn and compared.
missions.apart: Each map the sounds where you are and swap photos; see whose world is louder.

missions.title: Five-minute lamplight portraits
missions.description: Draw each other by the light of one lamp in five minutes flat, no erasing allowed.
steps: Turn off the big lights and switch on one cozy lamp.
Sit facing each other.
Set a five-minute timer and draw, no erasing.
Swap portraits, sign them and keep the ones you love.
missions.finish: Both portraits are done, signed and swapped.
missions.apart: Draw each other from a paused video call, then send photos of the results.

missions.title: Name the fish
missions.description: Visit an aquarium shop or public fish tank and give the fish names, personalities and backstories.
steps: Find a pet shop with fish tanks, a public aquarium or a big tank in a lobby or restaurant.
Each pick three fish to name.
Give each one a personality: the gossip, the bodyguard, the one who's always late.
Choose the fish you'd want as a roommate.
missions.finish: Six fish have names and one has been chosen as roommate.
missions.apart: Watch a free live aquarium cam together and name the fish on a call.

missions.title: Lyrics from memory
missions.description: Sing a song you're sure you know by heart, then check the real lyrics and count the mistakes.
steps: Each pick a song you'd swear you know every word of.
Sing the first verse and chorus without looking anything up.
Pull up the real lyrics.
Count the wrong lines and share your best misheard lyric.
missions.finish: Both songs are sung and fact-checked.
missions.apart: Sing to each other on a call, then check lyrics together.

missions.title: Chain reaction run
missions.supplies: Books, playing cards or dominoes, small toys
missions.description: Build a chain reaction from books, cards and toys that ends with a grand finale.
steps: Set up a row of standing books or cards on the floor.
Add a twist in the middle: a ramp, a rolling toy car, a falling spoon.
End with a finale, like a toy dropping into a cup or a bell ringing.
Film the run; if it stalls, fix it and try again.
missions.finish: Your chain reaction makes it all the way to the finale.
missions.apart: Each build a chain and start them at the same time on a call.

missions.title: Space photo from your birthday
missions.description: Look up the space photo NASA featured on each of your birthdays and decide whose is cooler.
steps: Search for NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day archive.
Find the picture from each of your birthdays (any year works).
Read the short descriptions to each other.
Vote on whose birthday sky wins, and save both.
missions.finish: You've both seen your birthday space photos and picked a winner.
missions.apart: Share links and compare on a call.

missions.title: Snack plate of your initials
missions.description: Build a snack plate using only foods that start with your initials.
steps: Write down both your first initials.
Hunt the kitchen for foods starting with those letters (J: jam, juice; S: seeds, salsa).
Arrange them in the shape of the letters on a plate.
Eat it and decide who got the luckier letter.
missions.finish: Your initials plate is built and eaten.
missions.apart: Each make a plate from your own kitchen and show it off on video.

missions.title: Sound impostor
missions.description: Fake an everyday sound using something totally unexpected, and see if your partner is fooled.
steps: Each pick a sound to fake: rain, footsteps in snow, a creaky door.
Find an unlikely object to make it, like rice in a bowl or a squeezed bag of flour.
Your partner closes their eyes and listens.
They guess the sound and the object you used.
missions.finish: Both sounds are faked and guessed.
missions.apart: Play on a call or send recordings back and forth.

missions.title: Guess what happens inside
missions.description: Walk past buildings without obvious signs and guess what goes on inside before checking.
steps: Walk a neighborhood with a mix of buildings.
Pick three that give nothing away.
Each make your best guess, the wilder the better.
Find the sign or look up the address to see who was closest.
missions.finish: Three buildings guessed and checked.
missions.apart: Each send a photo of a mystery building near you for the other to guess.

missions.title: Pop-up card landscape
missions.supplies: Thick paper or card, scissors, glue, pens
missions.description: Make a folded card with a little landscape that springs up when you open it.
steps: Fold a card in half and cut two short parallel slits into the fold.
Push the strip between them inside to make a pop-up tab.
Glue paper hills, trees or a tiny house onto the tab.
Write a note around the scene.
missions.finish: Your card opens and the landscape stands up.
missions.apart: Each make one and mail it to the other.

missions.title: Which is heaviest?
missions.supplies: Five household objects and a kitchen or bathroom scale
missions.description: Guess the weight order of five household objects, then check with a scale.
steps: Gather five objects that are hard to call: a shoe, a book, an orange, a mug, a remote.
Each secretly rank them heaviest to lightest.
Weigh them one by one.
One point for every object you placed correctly.
missions.finish: All five are weighed and a winner named.
missions.apart: Each weigh similar objects at home and compare guesses on video.

missions.title: Spice sniff test
missions.supplies: Five spices or herbs from your kitchen
missions.description: Close your eyes and identify spices and kitchen smells by nose alone.
steps: One of you secretly picks five jars or ingredients.
The other closes their eyes.
Hold each one under their nose for a sniff.
One point per correct guess, then swap with five new smells.
missions.finish: You've both sniffed and guessed five smells.
missions.apart: Each pull five jars with your eyes closed and guess on a call.

missions.title: Weird word origins
missions.description: Each pick a delightfully odd word and dig up the story of where it came from.
steps: Each choose a word you've always found strange, like 'nincompoop' or 'quarantine.'
Look up its origin.
Tell each other the story without reading it off the screen.
Vote on the wilder origin.
missions.finish: Both word stories are told.
missions.apart: Share your word stories in voice notes.

missions.title: Check in on someone quiet
missions.description: Each send a warm, no-pressure message to someone you haven't heard from in a while.
steps: Think of a friend or relative who's been quiet lately.
Write a short message that needs no long reply: 'Saw this and thought of you.'
Send it.
Tell each other who you wrote to and why.
missions.finish: Both messages are sent.
missions.apart: Send yours from wherever you are and swap stories later.

missions.title: Six-picture day
missions.description: Tell the story of a day you spent together as six tiny drawings in a row.
steps: Pick a day together you want to remember.
Draw six small boxes.
Fill each with one moment, from waking up to going to bed.
Add a one-line caption under each and date it.
missions.finish: Your six-picture day is drawn and captioned.
missions.apart: Draw three panels each and combine them into one strip.

missions.title: Riddle hunt around your home
missions.description: Write three riddles that send your partner around their own home to find everyday things.
steps: Each write three riddles for things every home has: 'I'm cold inside and light up when you open me.'
Send them all at once.
Your partner finds each answer and sends a photo of it.
Score a point for every riddle solved.
missions.finish: Both hunts are done and scored.
missions.apart: Made for distance: solve the riddles whenever you're home.

missions.title: Door color showdown
missions.description: Each pick a door color, then count them on a walk. The color with more doors wins.
steps: Each choose a door color: red, blue, green, black or yellow.
Walk a route together, counting doors as you spot them.
Keep your scores out loud so there's no cheating.
The winner picks the next movie, song or snack.
missions.finish: Your walk is done and one color has won.
missions.apart: Count on separate walks and see which of you lives on the more colorful streets.

missions.title: Light painting in the dark
missions.supplies: A phone with a night or long-exposure mode (or a free app), a flashlight, something to prop the phone on
missions.description: Turn off the lights, set your phone to a long exposure, and write glowing words in the air with a flashlight.
steps: Prop your phone up steady in a dark room and switch on night or long-exposure mode.
One of you starts the shot while the other draws in the air with a flashlight pointed at the camera.
Try a heart, your initials, a squiggly star.
Swap roles and pick the best glowing photo.
missions.finish: You've each made at least one light painting you love.
missions.apart: Each make a light painting where you are and send them over; try writing one word each to make a sentence.

missions.title: Three-line scene roulette
missions.description: Improvise a short scene that has to include three random lines pulled from a hat.
steps: Each write five random lines on slips: 'Is that a goose?', 'I've never trusted spoons.'
Fold them into a bowl.
Draw three and improvise a two-minute scene that fits them all in.
Draw again and swap characters.
missions.finish: Two scenes performed, every line used.
missions.apart: Text each other the lines and act them out on a video call.

missions.title: Shake your own butter
missions.supplies: Heavy cream, a jar with a tight lid, a pinch of salt, bread
missions.description: Pour cream into a jar, take turns shaking it like maracas, and spread your homemade butter on warm toast.
steps: Fill a clean jar halfway with cold heavy cream and close the lid tightly.
Take turns shaking it to a song, swapping every chorus.
Keep going past the whipped-cream stage until a lump of butter separates from the liquid.
Pour off the liquid, stir in a pinch of salt, and taste it on warm toast.
missions.finish: You've eaten toast with your own butter on it.
missions.apart: Shake your jars at the same time on a video call and race to butter.

missions.title: Get to know one tree
missions.supplies: A phone for a plant ID app or guide
missions.description: Pick one tree near you and get to know it: its leaves, its bark, its real name.
steps: Choose a tree you pass often.
Look closely at the leaf shape, bark and any seeds or flowers.
Use a free plant ID app or a guide to find its name.
Give it a nickname too, and say hi when you pass it.
missions.finish: Your tree has a real name and a nickname.
missions.apart: Each adopt a tree where you live and introduce it with photos.

missions.title: Childhood game night
missions.supplies: A board game, a deck of cards, or paper and pens
missions.description: Play a board game, card game or paper game one of you loved growing up.
steps: Each name a game you loved as a kid.
Pick one you can play tonight, or find a free paper-and-pencil version.
Teach the rules with a few stories from back then.
Play best of three.
missions.finish: You've played best of three.
missions.apart: Find a free online version or play a card game over video.

missions.title: One room, one hour
missions.supplies: A small notebook, if you like
missions.description: Visit a free museum and spend the whole time in just one room, looking slowly enough to actually notice things.
steps: Find a free museum or gallery and pick one room before you go in.
Each choose a piece to look at for five full minutes before saying anything.
Tell each other three things you noticed that you'd normally have walked right past.
Leave without seeing anything else, and save the rest for next time.
missions.finish: You've spent the hour in one room and swapped your best details.
missions.apart: Each pick one room in a museum's free online collection and describe your piece to each other on a call.

missions.title: Tap the song
missions.description: Tap a song's rhythm on the table and see if your partner can name it. It's harder than it sounds.
steps: Think of a famous song but don't say it.
Tap its rhythm on the table with your fingers.
Your partner gets three guesses.
Swap and play five rounds each.
missions.finish: Ten songs tapped and the scores totaled.
missions.apart: Tap on a call, close to the microphone.

missions.title: Mascot from the recycling bin
missions.description: Build a mascot for your two-person club out of boxes, bottles and cardboard tubes.
steps: Name your club: 'The Society of Late-Night Snackers.'
Raid the recycling for clean boxes, tubes and bottles.
Build a mascot that stands on its own.
Give it a name and display it somewhere proud.
missions.finish: Your mascot is standing and named.
missions.apart: Each build a mascot and introduce them over video.

missions.title: Window to somewhere far away
missions.description: Find a live webcam somewhere far away and watch it together like it's your window.
steps: Search for live webcams: a harbor, a zoo, a snowy mountain, a busy square.
Each pick one and show the other.
Watch one quietly for ten minutes, making up stories about what you see.
Bookmark your favorite for a cozy night.
missions.finish: You've watched a faraway place together for ten minutes.
missions.apart: Share your screen on a call and watch the same camera.

missions.title: Stop for the free show
missions.description: Find a free performance you'd normally walk right past, like a busker, open mic or park concert, and stay till the end.
steps: Check local listings, a library board or a busy square for something free this week.
Go, even if it's not your usual thing.
Stay for at least three songs, acts or pieces.
Each name your favorite moment on the way home.
missions.finish: You've watched a free performance and each picked a favorite moment.
missions.apart: Each catch something free near you, or watch the same free livestreamed concert on a call.

missions.title: Draw a bike from memory
missions.description: Draw a bicycle from memory in two minutes, then compare it with a real one and laugh.
steps: Set a two-minute timer.
Each draw a bicycle from memory: frame, pedals, chain, the lot.
Look up a photo of a real bike.
Award a prize for the most creative engineering.
missions.finish: Both bikes are drawn and compared with the real thing.
missions.apart: Draw on a call and hold your bikes up at the same time.

missions.title: Follow the color red
missions.description: Go for a walk where every turn is decided by the nearest red thing in sight.
steps: Start at your front door.
At every corner, turn toward the nearest red thing: a car, a door, a sign, a flower.
Keep going for twenty minutes, then find your way back.
Pick a new color next time.
missions.finish: You've followed the color for twenty minutes and made it home.
missions.apart: Each follow the same color on your own walk and compare where you ended up.

missions.title: Paper tangram animals
missions.supplies: A square of paper or card, scissors, a ruler
missions.description: Cut a square into seven tangram pieces and challenge each other to make animals from them.
steps: Look up a tangram template and cut a square into its seven pieces.
Each make an animal using all seven pieces.
Your partner guesses what it is.
Photograph the best ones.
missions.finish: You've each made and guessed at least two animals.
missions.apart: Each cut a set and challenge each other on a video call.

missions.title: Fortunately, unfortunately
missions.description: Tell a story together where every sentence flips between 'fortunately' and 'unfortunately.'
steps: One starts with a simple setup: 'A goat bought a bicycle.'
The other continues with 'Unfortunately...'
Keep alternating 'Fortunately' and 'Unfortunately' with each sentence.
Stop after twenty sentences or when you're laughing too hard.
missions.finish: Your story has reached twenty sentences or a total collapse into giggles.
missions.apart: Play over a call or in a voice-note chain.

missions.title: Snack from somewhere new
missions.description: Each pick a country you've never been to, find a simple snack from there, and make it together.
steps: Each choose a country you'd love to visit someday.
Find one easy snack from there that uses ingredients you can get.
Make both side by side.
Taste and look up one fun fact about each place.
missions.finish: Both snacks are made and tasted.
missions.apart: Make the same two snacks in your own kitchens on video.

missions.title: Origami teach-back
missions.description: Each learn a different origami fold from a video, then teach it to the other from memory.
steps: Each pick a simple model: a crane, a frog, a cup.
Learn it from a video until you can do it without looking.
Teach it to your partner from memory.
Line up all four models and admire your fleet.
missions.finish: You've each taught your model and made the other's.
missions.apart: Teach each other over a video call, holding your paper close to the camera.

missions.title: Bee buffet in a pot
missions.supplies: A pot or old container, soil, a packet of pollinator-friendly seeds
missions.description: Plant a pot of easy flowers that bees and butterflies love, and put it where they can find it.
steps: Choose seeds that suit where you live; a local garden center can suggest some.
Fill a pot with soil, sprinkle the seeds and cover them lightly.
Water gently and set it on a sunny windowsill, balcony or doorstep.
Give it a name and check on it together every few days.
missions.finish: Your bee buffet is planted, watered and named.
missions.apart: Plant the same seeds in your two places and send each other progress photos.

missions.title: Sealed predictions for next year
missions.description: Write specific, fun predictions about the next year and seal them away until it's over.
steps: Each write five specific predictions: 'We'll find a new favorite snack,' 'You'll learn a song on the ukulele.'
Make at least one silly and one sweet.
Seal them in an envelope with the opening date on the front.
Hide it somewhere safe and set a calendar reminder.
missions.finish: Your predictions are sealed and dated.
missions.apart: Write them on a call and seal yours where you are, or email them to a future date.

missions.title: Tiny game show from two rooms
missions.supplies: A video call, paper and pens
missions.description: Host a three-round game show over video, complete with a theme tune and a ridiculous prize.
steps: Each prepare one round: trivia about you, a drawing challenge or a speed quiz.
Pick a host name and hum a theme tune.
Play all three rounds, keeping score on paper.
Award a made-up prize, like the Golden Spoon.
missions.finish: Three rounds played and a champion crowned.
missions.apart: Made for distance: dress up for the cameras.

missions.title: How long is a minute?
missions.description: Guess when a minute has passed without looking at a clock, and test it somewhere calm and somewhere busy.
steps: Find a calm spot and start a hidden timer.
Each say 'now' when you think a minute has passed.
Check who was closest.
Try again somewhere busy and see if your minute changes.
missions.finish: You've tested two places and compared your minutes.
missions.apart: Do it in your own spots and swap results.

missions.title: One-lamp portrait lab
missions.description: Take three portraits of each other with one lamp: spooky, soft and mysterious.
steps: Turn off the big lights.
Light one face from below for spooky, from the side for mysterious, from the front for soft.
Take one portrait in each light.
Swap and pick your favorite moods.
missions.finish: You've both been photographed in three moods.
missions.apart: Light yourselves and take screenshots during a video call.

missions.title: Voice of a friendly monster
missions.supplies: A phone and a sock, glove or toy
missions.description: Invent the voice and sounds of a friendly little monster, then film a scene starring it.
steps: Turn a sock, glove or toy into a monster.
Invent its voice, its laugh and the sound it makes when it's hungry.
Film a 30-second scene where it meets the other person.
Watch it back with the sound turned up.
missions.finish: Your monster has a voice and a scene.
missions.apart: Each make a monster and film them meeting over video.

missions.title: Savory sundae
missions.supplies: Mashed potato, sauces, small toppings, a bowl
missions.description: Serve a savory snack dressed up as an ice cream sundae, like mashed potato 'ice cream' with gravy 'fudge.'
steps: Make a scoop of mashed potato, hummus or rice.
Add a sauce as the 'fudge.'
Top with 'sprinkles' like chopped herbs and a cherry tomato 'cherry.'
Serve it in a sundae glass if you have one.
missions.finish: Your savory sundae is served and eaten.
missions.apart: Each build a sundae and judge on looks and creativity on video.

missions.title: Same view, three lights
missions.description: Photograph one view in the morning, afternoon and evening and see how it changes color.
steps: Pick a window or view you can easily return to.
Take a photo in the morning.
Take another in the afternoon and one at dusk.
Put the three side by side and pick your favorite time.
missions.finish: You've got your three-photo strip.
missions.apart: Each shoot your own view and compare light across your places.

missions.title: Living-room cafe
missions.supplies: Snacks and drinks you already have, paper for a menu
missions.description: Run a pretend cafe at home for one evening, with a handwritten menu, a tea-towel apron and charmingly bad service.
steps: Name your cafe and write a menu of what's actually in the kitchen, with fancy descriptions.
One of you is the server first: greet, seat, take the order, recommend the 'special.'
Swap roles for the second course.
Each leave a review on a napkin before closing time.
missions.finish: Both of you have been served and left a napkin review.
missions.apart: Run your cafes on video, taking each other's orders and serving yourselves on the other's behalf.

missions.title: Souvenir from an ordinary errand
missions.supplies: A small jar or box at home
missions.description: Bring home one tiny free souvenir from a regular errand, like a leaf, a ticket stub or a funny flyer.
steps: Pick an errand you're doing anyway: groceries, the post office, the pharmacy.
On the way, each keep an eye out for a free little souvenir.
On the way home, tell the story of why you picked yours.
Drop both into a jar labeled 'Errand Souvenirs.'
missions.finish: Two souvenirs have gone into the jar.
missions.apart: Each grab one from your own errands and swap stories over a call.

missions.title: Our story in three songs
missions.description: Pick three songs that tell your story so far: the beginning, right now, and what's next.
steps: Each secretly pick a song for the beginning, the now and the future.
Reveal your lists one chapter at a time and explain your picks.
Agree on a final three, mixing and matching.
Listen to them in order with the lights low.
missions.finish: Your three-song story is chosen and played.
missions.apart: Make a shared playlist and press play at the same time on a call.

missions.title: Newspaper table challenge
missions.supplies: Old newspapers or scrap paper, tape, a hardcover book
missions.description: Roll old newspaper into tubes and build a little table strong enough to hold a book.
steps: Roll sheets of newspaper tightly into tubes and tape them closed.
Plan your design together: four legs, triangles for strength, a flat top.
Build a table at least as tall as a mug.
Test it with one book, then two, until it wobbles.
missions.finish: Your table holds at least one book for ten seconds.
missions.apart: Each build a table on a call and stack books on camera until one gives in.

missions.title: Shared whiteboard pictionary
missions.description: Open a free online whiteboard and draw on the same page at once: pictionary, silly portraits, a joint masterpiece.
steps: Open a free collaborative whiteboard and share the link.
Play three rounds of draw-and-guess.
Then draw a portrait of each other, together, one feature at a time.
Screenshot the final board and save it.
missions.finish: You've played three rounds and saved your joint portrait.
missions.apart: Made for distance: stay on a voice call while you draw so you can hear each other laugh.

missions.title: Invent a brand-new sport
missions.supplies: A soft ball or rolled-up socks, and two or three household objects
missions.description: Make up a gentle sport with a few things you have lying around, name it, and play a real match.
steps: Grab a soft ball and two or three random objects, like a bucket and a pillow.
Invent the rules: how you score, whose turn it is, one strange rule.
Play a five-minute match.
Fix one rule that didn't work, name the sport, and play the rematch.
missions.finish: Your sport has a name and a rematch has been played.
missions.apart: Invent a sport for a small indoor space and play your own matches side by side on video.

missions.title: Four-frame flipbook
missions.supplies: Sticky notes or small squares of paper, a pen
missions.description: Draw a four-frame animation on sticky notes and flip through it like a tiny cartoon.
steps: Pick a simple motion: a ball bouncing, a flower opening, a face winking.
Draw it in four frames, one per note, changing it a little each time.
Stack them in order and flip with your thumb.
Swap and watch each other's cartoon.
missions.finish: Both flipbooks have been flipped and admired.
missions.apart: Film your flipbook flipping and send the clip.

missions.title: Skyline in rectangles
missions.description: Draw the view from a high spot near you using only rectangles, then see whose skyline is more recognizable.
steps: Find a spot with a view of rooftops or buildings.
Each draw the skyline using only rectangles, no curves at all.
Allow yourselves one non-rectangle detail, like a tree or a cat on a roof.
Compare drawings and add the date.
missions.finish: Both skylines are drawn and dated.
missions.apart: Each draw your own skyline and swap photos; guess which buildings are which.

missions.title: Paper roller coaster
missions.supplies: Paper or card, tape, a big cardboard box, a marble or bead
missions.description: Build a paper track down the side of a box that carries a marble through one surprising turn.
steps: Fold strips of paper into U-shaped channels.
Tape them down the side of a box in a gentle zigzag.
Add one surprise: a loop, a jump, or a tunnel.
Test it, adjust, and film the first clean run.
missions.finish: Your marble makes it from top to bottom.
missions.apart: Build tracks on a video call and race your marbles at the same time.

missions.title: Maze with a silly rule
missions.description: Draw a maze for each other with one silly special rule, then race to solve them.
steps: Each draw a maze on a full sheet of paper.
Add one special rule: 'You must pass every star,' 'Avoid the dragons.'
Swap and solve at the same time.
First to finish without breaking the rule wins.
missions.finish: Both mazes are solved.
missions.apart: Send photos of your mazes, print or redraw them, and race on a call.

missions.title: Stale bread rescue
missions.supplies: Day-old bread, eggs or oil, and whatever toppings you like
missions.description: Turn bread that's past its best (but not moldy) into something better than it was fresh.
steps: Check the bread: dry is fine, any mold means it goes.
Each pick a rescue: French toast, garlic croutons, a bread pudding mug, crispy toast soldiers.
Cook both side by side.
Taste and decide which rescue becomes the house tradition.
missions.finish: Both rescues are cooked and one is declared tradition.
missions.apart: Each rescue your own bread on a video call and swap tips.

missions.title: See your own voice
missions.supplies: A phone or laptop with a microphone
missions.description: Use a free spectrogram app or website to see what your whistles, hums and laughs look like.
steps: Open a free spectrogram app or website.
Take turns humming low, then high, then sliding between them.
Try to 'draw' a shape, like a smile or a staircase, with your voice.
Screenshot your best drawing and your partner's laugh.
missions.finish: You've each drawn one shape with your voice.
missions.apart: Use the same site at home and send screenshots of your voice drawings.

missions.title: Offer a neighbor one small favor
missions.supplies: A friendly note or a quick knock
missions.description: Each offer one easy favor to a neighbor or nearby friend, like carrying groceries, taking the bins out or watering plants.
steps: Think of someone nearby who could use a hand: an older neighbor, a busy parent, a friend who's unwell.
Pick one small, specific favor you can actually do this week.
Offer it simply: 'I'm heading to the store, want me to grab anything?'
Do it, and tell each other how it went.
missions.finish: You've each offered and done one small favor.
missions.apart: Each help someone near you and swap the stories on a call.

missions.title: Junk drawer museum
missions.supplies: A junk drawer, box or bag full of random stuff
missions.description: Pull five objects out of a junk drawer or box and tell the memory behind each one.
steps: Open a drawer or box that's collected odds and ends.
Take turns pulling out one object at a time without looking.
Tell where it came from or make up a story if you can't remember.
Pick one to display on a shelf as the museum's star exhibit.
missions.finish: Five objects have stories and one is on display.
missions.apart: Each raid your own drawer and give a video tour of your exhibits.

missions.title: Learn the same trick, apart
missions.supplies: Whatever the skill needs: a deck of cards, two rolled-up socks
missions.description: Each learn the same beginner skill on your own, like a card trick or juggling two balls, then show off.
steps: Agree on one beginner skill and one free tutorial.
Practice on your own for twenty minutes during the week.
Meet on a video call and perform for each other.
Teach each other the step you found hardest.
missions.finish: You've both performed the skill on video.
missions.apart: Made for distance: send progress clips during the week to keep each other going.

missions.title: Oldest thing on the block
missions.description: Hunt your neighborhood for the oldest thing you can find: a date on a building, a worn step, a huge tree.
steps: Walk your block or a nearby street.
Look for dates on buildings, old signs, worn stone and ancient-looking trees.
Photograph each contender.
Look one up if you can and crown the oldest.
missions.finish: You've found at least three contenders and crowned one.
missions.apart: Each hunt where you live and compare your oldest finds.

missions.title: Describe it, draw it
missions.description: Describe a photo to your partner without showing it and see how close their drawing gets.
steps: Each pick a photo from your camera roll that your partner hasn't seen.
Describe it in detail for two minutes without naming what it is.
Your partner draws what they hear.
Reveal the photo and compare.
missions.finish: Both photos have been described and drawn.
missions.apart: Play on a voice call and send photos of your drawings.

missions.title: Pass it through the screen
missions.supplies: A phone, a small soft object each
missions.description: Film matching clips so an object seems to fly out of one person's frame and into the other's.
steps: Agree on the object (like a ball of socks) and the direction it travels.
One films themselves throwing it out of the right side of the frame.
The other films catching a similar object coming in from the left.
Put the clips together and do two more passes.
missions.finish: Your clip shows the object passing between you three times.
missions.apart: Made for distance: use a video call to check you're both throwing the same direction.

missions.title: Pancake art
missions.supplies: Pancake batter, cocoa powder or food coloring, a spoon or squeeze bottle
missions.description: Make pancakes with designs in two shades of batter: hearts, initials, faces or a tiny cat.
steps: Make a batch of batter and mix a little cocoa into one cup of it.
Drizzle a design with the darker batter first and cook for a few seconds.
Cover it with plain batter and flip when bubbles appear.
Reveal your designs and eat the masterpieces.
missions.finish: Each of you has made at least one design pancake.
missions.apart: Make pancakes on a video call and hold up your designs.

missions.title: Count the petals
missions.description: Look closely at five flowers and count their petals, spot their shapes and find the strangest one.
steps: Find five different flowers in a park, garden or pot.
Count the petals on each and look for patterns.
Photograph each one from directly above.
Pick the most unusual and look up what it is.
missions.finish: Five flowers counted and one identified.
missions.apart: Each find five flowers where you are and swap counts.

missions.title: Sock puppet comedy hour
missions.description: Make sock puppets and put on a short comedy show from behind the couch.
steps: Each make a sock puppet with a name and a personality.
Duck behind the couch or a table.
Have your puppets do a five-minute show: jokes, a song, a dramatic argument about cheese.
Take a bow and swap puppets for the encore.
missions.finish: Your puppet show has had an encore.
missions.apart: Perform with your puppets on video, one on each screen.

missions.title: Library lucky dip
missions.description: Pick a book from a shelf you've never visited at the library and read each other one page.
steps: Visit a library and each go to a section you never visit.
Close your eyes and pick a book off the shelf.
Find a quiet corner and read each other one page.
Borrow the better one, or just leave a sticky-note review in your memory.
missions.finish: You've each read a page from a book you'd never have picked.
missions.apart: Each try a library or a free e-book site near you and read your pages on a call.

missions.title: Kitchen slow dance
missions.description: Put on one song, turn the lights down, and slow dance however you like, socks and all.
steps: Pick one song that feels right.
Clear a little space and turn the lights down.
Dance however you want: swaying, spinning, or just holding on.
Pick the song for next week's dance.
missions.finish: One full song has been danced.
missions.apart: Play the same song at the same time and dance with each other on a video call.

missions.title: Longest chain from one sheet
missions.supplies: Two sheets of paper, scissors, glue or tape
missions.description: Make the longest paper chain you can from one single sheet of paper.
steps: Each take one sheet of paper.
Cut it into strips; thin strips make more links.
Loop and stick them into a chain.
Lay both chains out and measure.
missions.finish: Both chains are measured and one is longer.
missions.apart: Make your chains on a call and measure them on camera.

missions.title: How far is it, really?
missions.supplies: A phone or laptop with a map
missions.description: Guess the distance between three famous places, then check on a map.
steps: Pick three pairs: your two hometowns, two famous landmarks, the Moon and Earth.
Each write down your guess.
Check the real distance.
Closest guess wins each round.
missions.finish: Three pairs guessed and checked.
missions.apart: Guess over chat, then check on a call.

missions.title: Style each other from your closets
missions.description: Dress each other from your own wardrobes and do a mini fashion show.
steps: Each pick an outfit for the other from their closet.
Add one accessory as a surprise.
Get dressed and do a runway walk.
Rate each other's styling.
missions.finish: Both outfits have hit the runway.
missions.apart: Style yourself as your partner from your own closet and reveal on video.

missions.title: Five-word story ending
missions.description: Tell a story that must end with five words your partner picks in advance.
steps: Your partner gives you five random words, the stranger the better.
Tell a one-minute story whose final sentence uses all five.
Swap roles with five new words.
Vote on the more ridiculous story.
missions.finish: Both stories are told and voted on.
missions.apart: Text the words and tell stories on a call.

missions.title: Scout the best sunset spot
missions.description: Find the best place within walking distance to watch the sunset, then be there right on time.
steps: Look up today's sunset time and which direction the sun sets.
Each suggest a spot facing that way: a hill, a bridge, the end of a long street.
Walk to the more promising one and arrive fifteen minutes early.
Watch until the last color fades and rate the spot out of ten.
missions.finish: You've watched a whole sunset from your new spot.
missions.apart: Each watch the sunset where you are and send a photo at the best moment; if your time zones differ, trade sunrise for sunset.

missions.title: Salt-dough keepsakes
missions.supplies: Flour, salt, water, a baking tray, an oven, paint or markers
missions.description: Mix flour, salt and water into dough, shape little ornaments or handprints, and bake them to keep.
steps: Mix 1 cup flour, 1/2 cup salt and about 1/2 cup water into a smooth dough.
Each shape two small things: a handprint, a heart, a tiny version of something you love.
Poke a hole for hanging, then bake at 250°F (120°C) for about two hours until hard.
Once cool, paint or write the date on them.
missions.finish: Your keepsakes are baked, decorated and dated.
missions.apart: Make dough on a call, shape something for each other, and mail the finished pieces.

missions.title: Slow-motion action replay
missions.description: Act out a famous sports moment, or an everyday one, in extreme slow motion with live commentary.
steps: Pick a moment: a winning goal, a dramatic dive, or someone reaching for the last cookie.
One of you performs it in super slow motion, face and all.
The other gives breathless sports commentary.
Swap roles and do the 'instant replay' from a different angle.
missions.finish: You've each performed and commentated one replay.
missions.apart: Perform on video and take turns commentating.

missions.title: Wordless recipe comic
missions.supplies: Paper, pens, ingredients for two simple snacks
missions.description: Draw your favorite snack recipe as a comic with no words, then try to make each other's from the drawings alone.
steps: Each pick a simple snack you love making.
Draw the recipe in four to six panels with no words at all.
Swap comics and make the snack exactly as you understand the pictures.
Compare the result with the chef's real version.
missions.finish: Both snacks have been made from the comics.
missions.apart: Send photos of your comics, then make each other's snacks on a call.

missions.title: Zoom into a masterpiece
missions.description: Explore a famous painting online at super zoom and hunt for tiny details hardly anyone notices.
steps: Pick a busy painting with a high-resolution image online, like a crowded village scene.
Each zoom in and hunt for the strangest tiny detail.
Give your partner directions to it: 'Bottom left, by the man with the hat.'
Read up on one of the details you found.
missions.finish: You've each found and shared a hidden detail.
missions.apart: Share your screen on a call and take turns giving zoom directions.

missions.title: Hide five little notes
missions.description: Hide five small, kind notes for your partner to find over the next week.
steps: Each write five short notes: a compliment, a memory, a joke, a thank-you, a 'can't wait.'
Hide them where they'll turn up over the week: a coat pocket, a book, a lunch bag.
Don't drop hints.
Text each other a photo of every note you find.
missions.finish: All ten notes have been found.
missions.apart: Mail an envelope of five notes with 'open one a day' on the front, or schedule five texts.

missions.title: Camera roll blooper reel
missions.description: Dig through your camera rolls for blurry, mid-sneeze and accidental shots, and make a loving blooper reel.
steps: Each scroll back through your camera roll for outtakes: blinks, blurs, pocket photos.
Pick your five best, only ones you're both happy to include.
Put them together as a slideshow or collage with a silly title.
Watch it together and save it in a shared album.
missions.finish: Your blooper reel is made and saved.
missions.apart: Share your picks over a call and build the reel together.

missions.title: Same list, two places
missions.description: Find the same five everyday things where each of you is, and see how different your worlds look.
steps: Agree on a list: something yellow, something old, a sign with a number, a plant, something that made you smile.
Each go out or look around at home to find all five.
Send your photos at the same time, item by item.
Pick the pair that looks most alike and the pair that looks most different.
missions.finish: Both of you have found all five and picked your favorite pairs.
missions.apart: Made for distance: it works across streets or across oceans.

missions.title: Shadow tag
missions.supplies: A sunny day and an open, safe space
missions.description: On a sunny day, play tag by stepping on each other's shadows instead of touching.
steps: Find an open space, like a park or quiet square, with sun low enough to cast long shadows.
Whoever is 'it' tries to step on the other's shadow.
Hide your shadow in the shade of trees or buildings to stay safe.
Swap after each tag and play five rounds, at whatever pace suits you.
missions.finish: Five rounds played and nobody's shadow is safe.
missions.apart: Each go out on a sunny day and send the longest, strangest shadow photo you can make.

missions.title: Window silhouette portraits
missions.supplies: A phone camera and a bright window
missions.description: Stand in front of a bright window and take moody silhouette portraits of each other in profile.
steps: Turn off the room lights so the window is the only light.
Stand sideways between the camera and the window so your profile is clear.
Tap the bright window on the screen to make the person go dark.
Try three poses: thoughtful, laughing, mid-sneeze. Pick a favorite.
missions.finish: You each have a silhouette portrait you love.
missions.apart: Take silhouette selfies at your own windows and see whose profile is more dramatic.

missions.title: Ten-second makeover film
missions.description: Film a tiny before-and-after of something you really transform: a messy drawer, a plant repotting, a bed being made.
steps: Pick a small transformation you actually want to do.
Prop your phone and film a 'before' shot.
Do the job while the camera records, or take a photo every minute.
